jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The City of San Rafael is seeking a full\-time Program Coordinator to join our team at the Terra Linda Community Center/Pool. You will plan, coordinate and supervise recreation programs, events and activities, including planning, scheduling and implementing recreational activities; recruit, coordinate and supervise the activities of regular, temporary and volunteer staff; prepare program budgets and monitor expenditures; administer the rental, scheduling, use and maintenance of major recreation facilities. You will exercise judgement and initiative in the management of the Terra Linda Community Center/Pool.


***This position performs the following essential job duties: (including but not limited to). See full job description*** ***HERE.***


* Provides direction to and supervises regular, temporary and volunteer staff, including selecting, monitoring, training, scheduling and determining work loads; assists with hiring, disciplinary and evaluation processes.
* Plans, evaluates and coordinates programs, classes, athletic activities and special events, including scheduling facilities, ensuring facilities are set up, scheduling trips and hiring coaches.
* Monitors the day\-to\-day operations of programs and events, including making site visits, handling and resolving complaints not requiring the attention of a supervisor and ensuring that programs and events have required materials and supplies.
* Formulates and organizes program plans and schedules for seasonal and year\-round activities such as athletic leagues, aquatics programs, special events and day and summer camps.
* Acts as a liaison and representative with a variety of advisory boards, commissions, community groups, law enforcement agencies, schools, and councils.
* Creates program flyers, brochures, catalogs and newsletters, including determining content, layout, materials and distribution methods; prepares activity and operating reports.
* Enforces safety and operating procedures and provides for maintenance needs including compliance with health and safety codes and building codes.
* Books facility rentals for customers; attends to facility users needs, including permits and equipment; prints weekly event schedule and ensures that all setups are done, manages facility budget, including maintenance and supplies.

***Ideal Candidate*** for the Program Coordinator is a positive, organized, and people\-focused recreation professional who is excited to build great experiences for the community. You enjoy working with people, solving problems, and jumping in wherever needed to make programs run smoothly. This position supports both the Terra Linda Community Pool and the Terra Linda Community Center.


A major focus of this position is aquatics management, so we're looking for someone who is comfortable working in a busy pool environment and has an interest in developing their skill in aquatics safety, staffing, and programming. You'll help coordinate up to 100 seasonal aquatics staff, support staff training, manage contracts with outside user groups, oversee daily pool operations, and help ensure our programs are safe, welcoming, and fun.


The right person is organized and dependable, but also flexible and willing to get hands\-on when things don't go according to plan. You don't need to know everything on day one\-we're looking for someone who is eager to learn, takes initiative, communicates well, and is comfortable working as part of a team.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who likes working with people and wants to make a difference in their community. If you're excited by the idea of leading a team, funning successful aquatics and recreation program, and creating positive experiences for children, families, and staff, this could be a great fit.


***Education and/or Experience/Other:***


* Equivalent to graduation from a four\-year college or university with major coursework in recreation administration, physical education, leisure services or a related field and two years full\-time or its equivalent of recreation experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job as listed above.
* Must possess and maintain a valid California Class C driver's license and a satisfactory driving record.


Although not required at the time of hire, the ability to obtain the following certifications within the following timelines is required:


* American Red Cross Lifeguard Training \- within 6 months of employment
* American Red Cross Water Safety Instructor \- within one year of employment
* American Red Cross Lifeguard Instructor \- within one year of employment

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**
=================



We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end\-to\-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit\-out, and live, steady\-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well\-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual\-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross\-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.


**What You'll Do**
==================


**Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership**


* Own the end\-to\-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit\-out, and steady\-state operations.
* Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.
* Track and drive closure of cross\-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go\-live.
* Identify and escalate risks to go\-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.


**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.
* Partner with Construction teams to track handover status, outstanding items, and site readiness milestones.
* Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.
* Track hardware intake, rack\-and\-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.
* Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.
* Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.
* Take part in regular cross\-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.
* Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.


**Local Day Two Operations Readiness**


* Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.
* Create and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational processes required for local Operations teams to run the site post\-handover.
* Create the operational site tool bill of materials (BOM) required for local Operations teams to maintain the site post\-handover.
* Verify the spare parts bill of materials (BOM) is complete and in place ahead of Day 2 handover.
* Facilitate structured knowledge transfer and handover documentation from Construction, Network, and Compute teams to local Operations teams.
* Confirm monitoring, ticketing, and ITSM processes are validated and operating before a site is handed to local Operations.
* Act as an escalation point for local Operations teams during the early post\-handover period to smooth the transition.


**Reliability, Safety \& Compliance**


* Define and enforce Day 2 readiness criteria that a site must meet before transitioning to local Operations ownership.
* Facilitate root\-cause analysis for transition delays or gaps surfaced during handover, and drive remediation across teams.
* Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are validated and documented as part of readiness sign\-off.
* Support certification and audit readiness (ISO 27001, ISO 22237, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 22301\) ahead of go\-live.


**Vendor \& Supplier Coordination**


* Coordinate with construction contractors and colocation providers as needed to close out remaining items affecting the transition timeline.
* Track vendor commitments and SLAs relevant to the transition window, and escalate delays that put go\-live at risk.
* Coordinate with the Supply Chain team to align hardware intake and staging with the transition schedule.


**Monitoring, Reporting \& Analytics**


* Track KPIs and KRIs for the Day 0 to Day 2 transition process (time to transition, readiness checklist completion rate, post\-handover incident rate, etc.).
* Build and maintain dashboards that track transition status across your assigned site pipeline for all stakeholder teams.
* Produce regular reports for senior leadership on transition status, risks, and blockers.
* Use data\-driven insights to identify systemic bottlenecks in the Day 0 to Day 2 process and drive continuous improvement.

**About You**
=============


**Experience \& Background**


* 3\-8 years of experience in data centre operations, program/project management, or infrastructure deployment at scale.
* Proven track record coordinating the transition of new sites into live operations across construction, network, compute, and operations functions.
* Experience operating in a matrixed environment, influencing outcomes without direct authority over every stakeholder team.
* Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent site transitions in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment.
* Background in hyperscale, cloud, or HPC data centre environments (preferred).


**Technical Knowledge \& Expertise**


* Working knowledge of data centre power, cooling, networking, and compute infrastructure, sufficient to coordinate effectively across specialist teams.
* Familiarity with network deployment and cutover processes, and compute/hardware deployment lifecycles.

The Expansion Central Ops team is a global sub\-function within Delivery Commercial Operations (DCO). We are the "Scale Engine" for the Account Management (AM) organization. Our mission is to empower every Account Manager to maximize their portfolio's growth at scale by ruthlessly eliminating capacity and operational friction, while building the unified tooling and operational infrastructure that enables them to save time and multiply their market impact.
  

  

Whether optimizing workflow efficiency, strategic capacity allocation, or portfolio value execution, this team ensures that global AM segments (SMB, Enterprise, and Global Brands) can transition from a reactive operational state to a proactive, high\-velocity commercial growth model.
  

  

How do we replace friction with flow through technology? As a Senior Central Operations Manager focusing on AM Tooling \& Digital Transformation, you are a key architect of the daily digital experience for our Account Managers. Your mission is to move beyond routine tool maintenance into continuous operational innovation\-eliminating software friction by equipping AMs with integrated insights and streamlined workflows. You will help build and scale the "Unified Workspace," ensuring our tech stack empowers AMs to focus on high\-value commercial impact.

* Participate in "build vs. buy" evaluations and operational user research for next\-generation AM workspace enhancements, aligning commercial workflow needs with technical capabilities
* Partner closely with Tech, Product, and RevOps teams to define operational user requirements, prioritize software enhancements (e.g., Gainsight/CRM tools), and streamline front\-line interface workflows
* Identify opportunities to consolidate single\-use legacy applications into unified interfaces, measurably reducing system fragmentation and clicks\-to\-action for field teams
* Design and execute Go\-To\-Market (GTM) adoption strategies, training playbooks, and change management frameworks for new software rollouts to maximize field adoption and tool CSAT/NPS

jobs.title: Tasker Operations Manager (Spanish & English)
jobs.description:
**About Taskrabbit:**
---------------------



Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to\-do's, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.



At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast\-paced. We're looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data\-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we're creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.



Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025\) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!

**This role operates on a hybrid schedule requiring two days of in\-office collaboration per week. The position will be based out of our San Francisco office.**

  


**About The Role**



Taskrabbit connects busy people in need of help with trusted local Taskers who can lend a hand with everything from home repairs to errands, with the goal of being the number one home services platform in the countries we serve. A Tasker gets paid to do what they love, when and where they want — all while saving the day for someone in their city. The Tasker Operations team helps Taskers achieve their personal tasking goals using Taskrabbit. The Tasker Operations Manager plays a critical role in onboarding Taskers seamlessly, nurturing them, ensuring that they are fully utilized and retained, and building satisfaction with the platform. We're proactive—helping Taskers before they realize they need support. These approaches, employed at the local level, result in higher quality, more retentive, and more satisfied Taskers. The work you do will support our overall managed marketplace strategy, helping to ensure that every job gets done so well that Taskers and clients come back again and again.



You will be responsible for a specific set of metropolitan areas, driving key metrics for the company as well as supply alignment in those metros, which result in increased invoices and revenue. You will be the face of Taskrabbit to Taskers in your market and seen as a regional expert across the organization.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Drive invoices and revenue by analyzing supply data and taking targeted actions to improve supply health, booking conversion, and Tasker quality at key stages of the Tasker lifecycle—including activation, billing, retention, and churn. Advise and/or take direct action to acquire quality Taskers when needed.
* Act as a regional subject\-matter expert—monitoring market performance, responding to data trends, and tailoring programs and supply tactics to local dynamics and Tasker performance.
* Help Taskers in your Book of Business thrive through performance coaching (primarily in group settings) in person and virtually, at every stage of the Tasker lifecycle.
* Actively grow Tasker participation in scaled lifecycle programs to reach more Taskers. Determine the most effective communication channels to reach Taskers.
* Master the Tasker lifecycle and use data\-driven insights to identify gaps, recommend cross\-functional improvements, and drive better outcomes throughout the entire platform experience.
* Demonstrate strong data fluency to communicate performance insights and business impact to various teams and leadership.
* Design and lead experiments to improve supply alignment and Tasker success.
* Be a product expert. Know what features are live, how they work, and be able to explain them to an external audience. Validate and submit bug reports when we hear issues from Taskers.
* Lead community engagement efforts—hosting office hours, profile workshops, and Tasker socials to foster a vibrant and inclusive community.
* Work cross functionally with Product, Customer Support, Partnerships, Marketing, Legal, and other Commercial Operations teams to advocate for solutions that support Taskers and drive invoices and revenue.
* Share learnings, pitfalls, and wins with the global Tasker Operations team to improve programs and/or create new ones.
* Travel up to 10% for metro\-specific and team events.

**About You**
-------------


* Based in San Francisco or an easily commutable distance into this city, with availability to potentially travel to other main regions as required.
* 4\+ years in marketplace operations, customer success, community management, or comparable roles.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Full professional fluency in English and Spanish
* A proficient user of data to derive actionable insights and make decisions.
* A highly effective and confident communicator and negotiator virtually, on the phone, and in person; a skilled facilitator who can engage audiences from 1 to 100\.
* A self\-starter who's opportunistic and comfortable with problem\-solving on the fly in a fast\-paced environment and knows when to ask for help.
* A low‑ego collaborator who thrives in fast‑moving, globally distributed teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing and maintaining strong relationships with cross\-functional teams to drive results and achieve business objectives.
* An enthusiastic "people person" who derives joy from helping people succeed.
* Well organized with excellent time management and prioritization skills, and phenomenal attention to detail.
* Bring passion and playfulness to your work and those around you.
* Proficient with BI, Google Workspace, and customer success tools.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Experience managing community programs across multiple metr

This rich tapestry of culture and ideas is sustained by our City's commitment to heighten the quality of life for the diverse population of San Franciscans and residents of the greater Bay Area. Our employees play an important role not only in making our City what it is today, but also in shaping the future of San Francisco.


San Francisco International Airport (SFO) is one of the most dynamic and consequential airports in the world, serving as the primary international gateway to Northern California and Silicon Valley. As an enterprise department of the City and County of San Francisco, SFO welcomes over 54 million guests annually and offers nonstop service to more than 140 destinations worldwide on 50\+ airlines.


SFO is far more than a transportation hub. It is a recognized leader in environmental sustainability, equity, arts and culture, and forward\-thinking infrastructure. Our mission is to deliver an airport experience where people and our planet come first. Our core values of Safety and Security, Teamwork, Excellence, Care, and Equity guide everything we do as we build a supportive, purpose\-driven workplace where all employees can thrive.


SFO is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and lived experiences. Learn more about careers at SFO at flysfo.com, and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Threads.

 **Job Description**  

Under general supervision, the Airport Operations Supervisor supervises Airfield Safety Officers in duties which involve ensuring the safe, secure, and efficient operation of the Airside Operation which includes, Air Operations Area, Secured Area, and other airport facilities.


The essential functions of this classification include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Supervise Airfield Safety Officers and other subordinate staff and oversee the daily operations of a 24/7 section.
* Coordinate all airside activities with various Federal, State, and local agencies as well as other airport departments, tenants, and agencies, including escorts and remote aircraft parking.
* Coordinate airside construction and maintenance projects with various airport departments, tenants, and agencies.
* Proactively lead collaterals (programs, projects, initiatives, committees, etc.) to enhance the department
* Respond to all emergencies involving airport activities and coordinating Airside Operations emergency response.
* Act as Airside Operations’ liaison during V.I.P. operations.
* Prepare and present informational and operational briefings, presentations, and reports related to safety and security incidents and injuries; issue Notice to Air Missions (NOTAMs) to reflect changing airfield conditions and/or hazards to air traffic; participate in safety risk assessments via SFO’s Safety Management System (SMS).
* Interpret and enforce Airport Rules and Federal Regulations; admonish verbally or in writing, and issue citations for violations; input, review, and approve citations with software.
* Conduct basic investigation of infractions and administer progressive discipline**.**
* Represent Airside Operations in the Airport Integrated Operations Center (AIOC) and coordinate Airside information from the shift supervisor, manager(s), and/or director to the AIOC Team Leader.
* Refer noise complaints received to the Noise Abatement Division.
* Develop and administer training programs, standard operating procedures, and other related programs; prepare and maintain training syllabus and records for Airfield staff.
* Develop and administer training for wildlife management; oversee the wildlife hazard management program including habitat control, harassment, depredation, and safe use of firearms.
* Involvement in managing daily Airside Operations in the collaborative setting of a control center type environment.
* Perform other functions outlined in the 9221 Airport Operations Supervisor.


Nature of Work: Staff in this role support a 24/7 emergency response operation.

 **Qualifications**  

* **Education:** High school diploma or equivalent (GED or High School Proficiency Examination) **AND**
* **Experience:** Four (4\) years of safety and/or security operations experience at an airport, airbase, airline, or military base performing safety, security and inspection duties

jobs.title: Plumbing Project Manager
jobs.description:
Ayoob \& Peery is a locally owned mechanical contractor based in San Francisco.

Our focus is in wet side mechanical building systems, including general plumbing, steam heating, hydronics, and fire protection. As a design/build firm, we provide solutions for projects of all stages – from early design and development to construction and operations.

We are seeking to fill a **Plumbing Project Manager** position on our project management team in San Francisco.

The Plumbing Project Manager will lead all phases of commercial plumbing construction projects, from pre\-construction and buyout through final closeout. This role directly contributes to project success by owning financial performance, managing schedules, and fostering strong relationships with clients, general contractors, and field teams. Ultimately, the Plumbing Project Manager will ensure complex plumbing systems are delivered safely, on time, and under budget, contributing to the company's overall profitability and reputation for high\-quality installation.

All positions available include competitive pay and benefits package.

Job Responsibilities:

* Lead and manage all aspects of assigned commercial plumbing projects, ensuring they meet financial, quality, and safety goals.
* Develop, track, and manage project budgets, including accurate forecasting, cost\-to\-complete analysis, and monthly WIP (Work in Progress) reporting.
* Negotiate, estimate, and process change orders with clients, general contractors, and subcontractors.
* Collaborate with plumbing superintendents and field foremen to develop, monitor, and update project schedules and manpower loading.
* Lead the project buyout process by negotiating and issuing purchase orders for plumbing fixtures, pipe, valves, fittings, and sub\-tier trades (e.g., insulation, core drilling).
* Oversee and mentor Assistant Project Managers (APMs) and Project Coordinators in the processing of plumbing submittals, fixture cuts, RFIs, and document control.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, attending job walks, OAC (Owner\-Architect\-Contractor) meetings, and leading project presentations.
* Identify and mitigate potential project risks, design clashes, and schedule delays before they impact the job.
* Partner with the safety team to ensure strict adherence to all project safety plans, especially regarding trenching, rigging, and job site hazards.
* Oversee the successful turnover and closeout of projects, including punch lists, warranties, and O\&M manuals.

Job Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or equivalent experience (candidates who have transitioned from the trades as a Journeyman/Master Plumber are highly encouraged to apply).
* 5\+ years of proven experience as a Project Manager specifically focused on commercial plumbing construction.
* Strong working knowledge of the California Plumbing Code (CPC) and standard industry practices.
* Strong financial acumen with a track record of successfully managing project P\&L and billing cycles.
* Proficiency in construction management and estimating software (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, ERP systems).
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Advanced ability to read, interpret, and identify discrepancies in complex plumbing blueprints, isometric drawings, and specifications.
* Familiarity with construction scheduling software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera P6\).
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Valid driver's license, with the ability to travel to various job sites throughout the Bay Area.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $60\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

License/Certification:

* Driver's License (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Design Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **The Role**



As a **Design Program Manager** at Everlaw, you'll establish the operating system for our growing product design team, bringing structure, visibility, and predictability to how we design AI\-powered litigation tools. As our first dedicated Design Program Manager, you'll absorb operational friction and cross\-functional complexity so product designers can focus entirely on craft, quality, and solving complex user workflows.


**This is a full\-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**


#### **What you'll do**


* Own the design operating model for planning and delivery — define how design work is estimated, sequenced, and handed off, and maintain the system that makes dependencies and timeline risk visible before they become escalations.
* Define design readiness criteria and coordinate pre\-launch quality reviews to ensure shipped features meet high standards for craft, responsiveness, accessibility, and edge cases.
* Own the working interfaces between Design, Product Management, Engineering, User Research, and Technical Writing — define how scope is agreed, how dependencies are tracked, and where conflicts get decided, so those questions have a standing answer instead of being renegotiated per project.
* Build and champion lightweight design operations rhythms, frameworks, and templates—such as design briefs and critique structures—to streamline team workflows.
* Manage design resourcing and bandwidth tracking to inform staffing decisions, highlight capacity constraints, and help leadership plan for future team growth.
* Own how design's work is represented to the business — build and maintain the reporting layer (capacity, throughput, readiness) that lets product and executive leadership plan against design, rather than assembling narrative updates each cycle.

#### **About You**


* You have at least 5 years of experience in Design Program Management or Design Operations supporting product design teams in complex, enterprise B2B SaaS or data\-heavy environments.
* You excel at balancing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, steering teams through ambiguity with structure, clear prioritization, and empathy.
* You've built and scaled lightweight design operations frameworks, delivery plans, and resource tracking processes without stifling creative momentum.
* You bring excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to translate design progress and complex trade\-offs into business\-relevant narratives for leadership.
* You bring a strong understanding of user\-centered design methodologies, modern UX workflows, and tools like Figma.
* You have experience working with project tracking tools like Jira or emerging AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Design).
* You operate with a low\-ego, highly collaborative style, finding genuine fulfillment in making design teams visible and successful.
* You are authorized to work in the United States without restrictions. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring F\-1 visas, including OPT, for this role.


Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.


### **The Team — Product**



The Product team shapes products used by everyone from document reviewers and corporate teams to government attorneys and law firm partners, each with distinct needs across a broad and complex domain. The team brings together user insight, market context, business priorities, design, and technical feasibility to decide what Everlaw builds and why. This work turns deeply capable technology into intuitive experiences and helps define the next era of legal work.


### **Total Rewards \& Benefits**



The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $178,000\. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.


#### **Health \& well\-being**


* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company\-sponsored life and disability insurance

#### **Financial rewards**


* Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long\-term growth
* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

#### **Growth \& everyday perks**


* 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company\-wide days off) per year
* Annual allocation for learning \& development and relevant professional membership dues
* Hybrid work with regular work\-from\-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company\-wide events in our offices

### **About Everlaw**



When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

jobs.description:
***Collaborative people. Progressive builders.***


Consistently recognized as a best workplace, and for our commitment to safety, sustainability, and community partnerships, BNBuilders hires the very best in the construction industry and strives to create an environment that encourages innovation, responsibility, and client satisfaction. If you are looking to be a part of an open, supportive team and receive exciting challenges that promote personal and professional growth, look no further than BNBuilders!

 **JOB SUMMARY:**


The Self\-Perform Project Manager provides operational and financial management support for the self\-perform projects. This role will be the main liaison between the Drywall and General Contractor Project Teams throughout the duration of the project(s).

 **SALARY RANGE:** $140,000 \- $180,000 annually

 **BENEFITS:**

* Group medical, vision, and dental insurance, including a choice of two benefit plans \- a PPO plan and a High Deductible/ Health Savings Account plan with company contribution to HSA.
* Company\-paid short and long\-term disability plans, group life insurance, and AD\&D plans.
* Untracked/unmeasured vacation.
* Sick leave accrued at 1 hour of sick leave for every 30 hours worked with an annual carryover of 80 hours.
* 9 paid holidays each year.
* Paid parental leave.
* Annual discretionary bonus based on company profitability and your manager's assessment of your performance.
* A 401(k) savings plan under which BNB matches the first 3 percent of your deferral with a 100% match and the next two percent with a 50% match for a total matching contribution of 4% of your pay. You are immediately 100% vested in all contributions (including BNB match). We provide both traditional (pre\-tax) and Roth (post\-tax) contribution options.
* We are proud to be an employee\-owned company. This means you get an ownership stake in BNB through a benefit called an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). It's 100% company\-funded and is invested in BNBuilders stock. You can participate in this long\-term plan after you complete 1 year of service (with at least 1,000 hours).
* Vehicle/Vehicle allowance, fuel card, and toll pass.

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Exercise general supervision of multiple job sites to monitor and manage projects during each phase of construction; including but not limited to pre\-construction, construction, closeout, and post\-construction.
* Create and execute project work plans and makes appropriate revisions to meet changing needs.
* Identify resources needed and assigns individual responsibilities.
* Manage day\-to\-day operation aspects of a project and scope.
* Prepare and manage change orders.
* Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately.
* Develop cost\-effective plans and schedules for completion of projects following a logical pattern for utilization of resources.
* Responsible for ensuring that construction activities move according to predetermined schedule and project profitability forecast, monitoring the progress of construction activities on a regular basis and holding regular status meetings.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure all pertinent information is provided; proactive communication with field leaders on bid productions, RFI’s, and scope changes and maintains consistent communication throughout the project.
* Maintain strict adherence to the budgetary guidelines, quality, and safety standards.
* Proactively raise issues with the Team that may prevent flow and production.
* Meet with the Team as required to review change orders, roadblocks, production tracking, RFI’s, etc.
* Assist and mediate issues in the field. Document solutions, agreements and/or direction.
* Project accounting functions including managing the budget and preparing monthly project cost projections.
* Submit monthly billings for self\-performs scopes.
* Approve and reconcile vendor invoices.
* Negotiate and advocate for safety, quality, and production.
* Promote strong team morale.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\+ years or more of experience in the commercial drywall industry.
* Proven ability to coach and develop others and possess a team player mentality.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Detail\-oriented, deadline/goal\-driven.
* Ability to communicate effectively with team and clients.

  



**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:***The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

  

Capable of traversing over construction\-type terrain when under development; moving through the construction site and the materials in place for use on the site; climbing ladders and temporary stairways; conducting visual inspections of quality of construction and materials being used in construction. Conduct jobsite walks to ensure successful project completion. Conduct jobsite walks to identify and eliminate safety hazards.

 **WORK ENVIRONMENT:***The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

  

BNB believes in collaboration, team\-building, and a strong supervisor/employee relationship. To accomplish this, the duties of this role are not performed in a remote capacity, and we expect that all employees will complete work in an office/job site setting.

  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at the job site. The noise level in the work environment and job site can be loud.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Defense Innovation
jobs.description:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.  

  

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

**About the Position**
======================



Dexis Professional Services (Dexis) is seeking a Contract Program Manager (PM) who will be responsible for the management and oversight of contract performance supporting the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU). The PM will provide management, direction, administration, quality assurance, and leadership of the execution of a task order (TO), including assigning tasks to contractor personnel, supervising ongoing technical efforts, and managing overall TO performance. The PM shall be responsible for the quality and efficiency of the TO, including technical issues and business processes. The PM will retain the authority to make decisions for Dexis in response to Government issues, concerns, and comments, as well as be proactive in alerting the Government to potential contractual, programmatic, and resource limitation issues.



The Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) facilitates collaborative partnerships between the Department of War (DoW), venture\-backed technology companies, and other non\-traditional innovation communities to expand the national security innovation base and address national security challenges. Doing so enables the DoW to leverage its unique acquisition process, reducing procurement timelines, and accelerating the integration of commercial solutions into defense operations. The DIU enterprise encompasses expertise, capabilities, and relationships across several commercial technology areas; public and private sectors; academia; and other communities of interest both United States (U.S.)\-based and internationally.



The PM will oversee a contract providing back\-office support services for DIU, so DIU can meet its objectives of accelerating the identification, acquisition, prototype, and transition of stable commercial technologies across the DoW, thus, delivering innovation at commercial speeds and greater scale with an emphasis on solutions most effective in a joint\-warfighting environment. The contract will provide support in the areas of information technology (IT), security and facilities, contracting and acquisitions, program management support, strategic communications, Congressional affairs, resource management, human resources, office of the general counsel, and records management.



The position requires an active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and will be based in Mountain View, CA at DIU's headquarters location with flexibility to travel to other DIU sites including within the National Capital Region. This position is contingent upon contract award.


**Responsibilities**
====================


* Oversee contract execution, ensuring compliance with contract objectives.
* Manage relationships with the client.
* Lead a large, geographically dispersed and multidisciplinary team, ensuring collaboration, coordination, and clear internal team communication.
* Ensure deliverables, products, services, and personnel meet government needs and expectations.
* Provide innovative approaches to team management.
* Provide technical support, leadership, and creation of processes in execution of the contract.
* Lead quality assurance and technical excellence of work on the contract and team; ensure deliverables and products are delivered timely and of quality acceptable to both the client and Dexis.
* Identify and mitigate schedule, performance, technical, and financial risks.
* Conduct cost monitoring and variance analysis.

**Qualifications**
==================


* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
* Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.
* At least five (5\) years of program management experience within the last ten (10\) years supporting large staffing efforts or projects of similar scope and complexity for the DoW, including support for operations, information management, and innovation of technologies.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-disciplinary teams, managing schedules, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and supporting senior government stakeholders, preferably at DIU.
* Experience supporting DIU enterprise support functions and organizational operations, including with familiarity of contract support across the organization.
* Experience implementing and utilizing program management tools and software solutions.
* A current Project Management Institute (PMI) Project Management Professional or Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification.
* Exceptional client relationship management and executive communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited college/university.
* 10 years of experience managing DoW projects of similar scope and complexity.
* Private\-sector experience working with defense technology companies, nontraditional defense contractors, venture\-backed firms, or organizations supporting the defense innovation ecosystem.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with senior government, military, industry, and acquisition stakeholders associated with the DIU enterprise.
* Familiarity with the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU), defense acquisition pathways, commercial technology transition, and public\-private partnership models.

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in program management.
* 7 years of experience in leadership roles with/without direct reports.
* Experience leading technical programs in data centers or networking technologies.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience managing cross\-functional/team projects.
* 10 years of experience in a formal technical program management role.
* 10 years of experience working in a technological field with rapid rates of technology change.
* 10 years of experience demonstrating capabilities to influence across a broad, cross\-functional organization.
* Familiarity with network planning and engineering, including data center network engineering in complex environments.
* Strong knowledge of qualifications of network deployments, optical systems, and machine learning infrastructure.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Server Operations team monitors the physical and network infrastructure behind Google’s technology and holds responsibility for keeping the servers, networks, and logistics processes in Google’s global fleet of data centers running smoothly and efficiently.


Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a member of Fleet Management at Google, you will develop relationships, both internally and externally, and connect with internal customers and partner teams to develop an understanding of their business requirements and goals.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $240000 \- $333000 (USD) \+ 25% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., Site Reliability Engineering, Third\-Party Data Centers) on network architecture and provide valuable feedback on the physical data center environment.

* Develop a unified global network program process and prioritization to create agility to accommodate shift\-left priority to enable an engaged advantage for Google.
* Ensure GSO is an asset across all Google\-required network infrastructure, focusing on network capacity in support of the end customer.

jobs.title: Project Manager, CMC
jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Administration
* JOB218728


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Fluorescence Imaging at Intuitive Surgical**


The Fluorescence Imaging Team at Intuitive is developing agents designed to work seamlessly with Intuitive’s robotic platforms and Firefly imaging technology. The agents have the potential to highlight critical anatomy and disease in real time—giving surgeons clearer information at the moment decisions matter most and helping improve outcomes for patient*s.*


**Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position**


The CMC Project Manager serves as a strategic and operational partner to Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) leadership, providing integrated project management for development programs from clinical development through regulatory submission, launch readiness, and commercialization. The role translates CMC strategies and technical decisions into coordinated cross\-functional project plans that enable effective execution.


Reporting to the Program Management \& Operations organization, the CMC Project Manager partners with CMC, Manufacturing, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Clinical Supply, Clinical Development, Commercial, Finance, Procurement, and external partners to integrate timelines, risks, dependencies, budgets, and technical decisions into unified project plans.


**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Support the Program Management \& Operations team in implementing CMC governance processes, including governance forums, operating cadences, decision pathways, program reporting, and the RAID framework.
* Facilitate CMC governance by preparing materials, maintaining RAID and decision logs, documenting actions and decisions, monitoring follow\-through, and escalating cross\-functional risks and decision requests, as appropriate.
* Develop, maintain, and communicate detailed CMC project plans for assigned programs, including milestones, dependencies, critical\-path activities, document workflows, key cGMP deliverables, stability pulls and reports, regulatory commitments, and cross\-functional deliverables.
* Coordinate execution across Drug Substance, Drug Product, Manufacturing, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Clinical Supply, and external partners, providing hands\-on project management support to assigned CMC workstreams.
* Monitor execution and proactively identify schedule impacts, resource constraints, cross\-functional dependencies, technical and operational risks, and potential budget impacts.
* Facilitate the development and implementation of mitigation plans.
* Develop and apply governance and project reporting materials that communicate milestone performance, critical\-path status, key risks, decision requests, budget impacts, and recommended actions to leadership and PM\&O teams.
* Support regular functional\-area budget management in coordination with CMC Functional Area Team Leads and PM\&O by tracking actual and forecasted accruals, invoices, purchase orders, and inputs to the Annual Operations Budget Planning Cycle.
* Support CDMO and supplier oversight by: incorporating vendor updates into project plans and governance materials; tracking purchase orders, change orders, invoices, key contract terms, and performance commitments; and coordinating business reviews and operational follow\-up across internal functions.
* Drive adoption of standardized project management tools, templates, dashboards, reporting practices, and workflow automation that improve portfolio visibility, consistency, and execution.

### **Qualifications**


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree is preferred.
* Minimum 8 years of combined experience in CMC development and project management within the pharmaceutical industry, supporting small\-molecule development programs from clinical development through NDA submission and launch readiness.
* Demonstrated success in cross\-functional coordination with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Clinical Development, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to support program planning, governance, and decision\-making.
* Expertise in timeline management, risk and issue management, resource coordination, budget tracking, vendor coordination
* Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver clear, actionable project updates and drive alignment without direct authority.
* Proficiency with Smartsheet, including detailed project planning, dashboards, reporting, and workflow automation.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience supporting NDA Module 3 preparation and submission
* Experience managing CDMOs (and other suppliers)
* PMP or comparable project management certification.
* Familiarity with procurement, contracting, and financia

jobs.title: Corporate Real Estate Transaction Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**  

We are seeking a strategic and highly execution\-oriented Corporate Real Estate Transaction Program Manager to support a fast\-growing tech company. In this role, you will program manage the lifecycle of real estate leasing transactions, from initial market analysis through technical due diligence and executive approvals to lease execution and provide day\-to\-day support to the transaction team.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

Program Leadership \& Initial Search Strategy
  
**Strategic Market Search:** Define and prepare project requirement statements and geographic search boundaries.
  
**Geospatial Tracking:** Track viable options and manage building information using mapping tools and spreadsheets.
  
**Market Evaluation:** Direct the gathering of local market intelligence reports to identify viable market opportunities.
  
Market Tours and Technical Due Diligence
  
**Market Tour Coordination:** Orchestrate property tours for stakeholders and consultants.
  
**Site Feasibility:** Gather property data points including ingress/egress, power availability, site plans, structural floor plans, critical technical specifications and zoning information.
  
Deal Underwriting \& Negotiating Process
  
**Negotiation Process Tracking:** Monitor offer letter exchanges through lease execution.
  
**Document Management:** Organize due diligence and transaction documents.
  
**Financial Analysis:** Evaluate building options and continuously update financial models across negotiation cycles.
  
Executive Approval \& Transaction Closing
  
**Executive Approval Decks:** Assist with committee approval decks containing business\-critical underwriting, maps and photos, and operational building facts (e.g., square footage, lease commencement dates, technical specifications).
  
**Lease Verification:** Cross\-verify that final agreed business terms are accurately translated into leases.
  
**Cross\-Functional Governance:** Delegate specialized lease clauses to internal stakeholders for their respective reviews.
  
**Risk Auditing:** Track real\-time program milestones and actively flag missing due diligence tasks.
  
  

**What You’ll Need:**  

Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, preferred. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  
2\-5 years of relevant experience, corporate real estate program management or senior transaction advisory experience, preferred.
  
Ability to use existing procedures to solve standard problems.
  
Experience with analyzing information and standard practices to make judgments.
  
In\-depth capability with Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Docs, My Maps), workflow management and messaging tools. MS Office.
  
Organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
  
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

* Previous experience as a top\-performing account manager or sales executive
* Proven track record of team quota\-attainment via new product sales and upgrades
* Proven leadership skills, people management skills
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts \- able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Eager for a very hands\-on role, where you’ll be asked to take on and run with a range of projects outside your comfort zone, and learn quickly
* Highly organized, self\-motivated and detail\-oriented, with great follow\-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity individual who’s enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it.

**Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.**



More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it's because they are employed by a company that doesn't offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium\-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.



We're a high\-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.


**About the role**



Our Partnership Program is a key initiative for the company. The Partner Account Manager's primary duty is to engage, build and develop Human Interest's key accounts and growth opportunities. We're looking for a forward\-thinking, meticulously organized, and self\-motivated sales professional who can thrive in a fast\-paced environment. You'll accelerate our partner relationships to help us exponentially reach more small and medium businesses across the United States, which is essential to our growth. This role requires someone who is proactive, creative, and can exercise their own discretion and judgment to create their own solutions when needed.


**What you get to do every day**

We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest's unique view on what's important and what's right. jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **Change the way the world travels**



Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it's all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary \- including yours.



Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.


### **Team mission**


We're looking for an Account Manager to join our Sales team in San Francisco You'll own a book of business made up of mid\-market supplier partners across the US and Canada, with full accountability for their performance, satisfaction, and commercial growth on our platform.



You'll build trust \& influence with your accounts, act as their strategic partner, and find every opportunity to help them thrive. That means pitching new expansion ideas, solving problems, digging into data, and showing up for your partners in a way that makes GetYourGuide their most valuable business relationship.



This is a role for someone who's commercially sharp, genuinely curious, and excited about being part of a company that's redefining how people explore the world.


**Please note we operate hybrid working:** Monday, Tuesdays and Thursdays in office, and Wednesday and Friday remote days.


### **Your mission**


* Manage and grow a book of business consisting of mid\-market supplier accounts (tours, activities, and experience providers), understand your assigned market(s), and hit your performance targets

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, corporate/internal communications, management consulting, Google Ads sales or sales enablement, or a related field.
* 3 years of project management experience working across cross\-functional teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating high\-level strategies into polished assets alongside creative partners, video producers, and agencies.
* Experience in, experimenting with and leveraging emerging AI tools to optimize daily workflows or enhance creative output.
* Sharp critical thinking and creative investigative skills to structure and resolve complex operational issues.
* Strong background in Google Ads products, sales tech, or market trends, with an active drive to simplify sellers' day\-to\-day workflows.
* Proven track record as a versatile all\-rounder managing multiple workflows and shifting priorities in changing environments.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Creative in Marketing, you bring visual, design, written and experiential acumen to Google products and services, presented across all major media, content, channels, and experiences. You have the ability to perform your role in a flexible, ever\-changing environment and must be open to new influences and inspiration. You will work with a deeply cross\-functional team and inspire a team of vendor partners by sharing ideas and developing effective solutions to generate multiple concepts supporting all forms of major media. You will be equally comfortable making; rolling up your sleeves and designing, mocking, writing, or prototyping; showing, not telling. Above all, you will inspire and lead by example by making the most of every opportunity to develop breakthrough creative, consistent with the Google Marketing brand, and be able to take and provide clear direction and creative feedback that pushes work forward.

As a Marketing and Communications Manager on the Google Compute Engine (GCE) Marketing team, you will be an all\-rounder combining structured thinking, compelling storytelling, and rapid execution. You will pivot seamlessly from drafting concise executive updates to creative seller\-facing narratives, high\-level strategy, or asset production (videos, templates). You will translate complex AI and product concepts into clear stories, thriving in ambiguity to address whatever issues come next.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $116000 \- $166000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Craft beautifully written, punchy, and highly polished communications, executive updates, newsletters, and slide copy that make complex Ads products, sales training initiatives, and AI tools instantly understandable.
* Pivot fluidly between high\-level planning, operational execution, and creative copywriting as business priorities shift.
* Synthesize complex leadership discussions and data points into crisp action items, and design polished, narrative\-driven decks for high\-stakes executive discussions.
* Lead collaborative initiatives across global product, sales, and engineering teams, translating complex strategies into seller\-first framing.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Trading Operations Associate - West Coast
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


**Alpaca is a US\-headquartered, global leader in agent\-first brokerage infrastructure** for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.  

  

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional\-grade APIs. This includes broker\-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.  

  

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open\-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award\-winning, developer\-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.  

  

**Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top\-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.**  

  

**Our Team Members:**



We're a dynamic team of 400\+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!  

  

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

**Your Role:**



As an Trading Operations Associate, you will provide high\-quality support to enterprise\-level clients, addressing issues related to order entry, execution, best ex, trade surveillance and high\-touch order handling. You will build and maintain strong relationships, proactively monitoring client trading activity to ensure smooth operations. Collaborating with trading operations desks, IT, and compliance teams, you'll resolve issues and offer relevant market insights. Additionally, you will ensure all trading activities comply with regulatory requirements while identifying and addressing potential risks. Your role will also involve gathering client feedback to enhance services and tools.


**Key Responsibilities:**


**Customer Support:**


* Deliver high\-quality support to enterprise\-level clients through various channels (phone, email, chat).
* Investigate and resolve issues related to account management, order entry, processing, execution, FIX sessions, and OMS functionality.
* Assist clients with troubleshooting and technical issues to ensure seamless operations.


**Trading Services:**


* Monitor client accounts and trading activity for anomalies, providing timely alerts and support as necessary.
* Stay informed on market developments and trading infrastructure to offer relevant guidance and insights to clients.
* Monitor corporate actions, including dividends, stock splits, mergers, and other events, ensuring accurate and timely communication and resolution.


**Collaboration and Feedback:**


* Work closely with trading desks, operation, IT, and compliance teams to address and resolve client issues efficiently.
* Collect client feedback and share insights with product development and management teams to refine services and tools.


**Compliance and Risk Management:**


* Ensure all client interactions and trading\-related activities adhere to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Proactively identify and address potential risks associated with client operations and trading processes.


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* At least 2\-3 years of experience in brokerage operations, trading, or a related field.
* Proven experience in customer support, relationship management, and trading services.
* Demonstrated experience with trading platforms and equities trading and familiarity with FIX protocol. Options experience is a plus.
* Must either possess FINRA series 7, 63 or local equivalent with a willingness to obtain in the first 6 months.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain client relationships.
* Excellent English written and verbal communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proficient verbal communication skills in a language other than English. Japanese or Korean are a plus.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* High ethical standards and a commitment to maintaining confidentiality.

### **How We Take Care of You:**


* Competitive Salary \& Stock Options
* Health Benefits
* New Hire Home\-Office Setup: One\-time USD $500
* Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card


*Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.*

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

The Office Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day operation of the office, firm\-wide administrative support, and coordination of office, safety, onboarding, and internal events. This role partners closely with the Executive Team, HR, Property Management, and external vendors to ensure a well\-run, organized, and welcoming workplace. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, discretion, and a proactive, service\-oriented mindset

**Key Responsibilities**

**Office Operations \& Compliance**

* Maintain full knowledge of and administer key compliance policies, including the Business Continuity Plan (BCP), Injury and Illness Prevention Program (IIPP), and Workplace Violence Prevention Plan (WVPP).
* Monitor regulatory changes in workplace safety; recommend and implement updates to internal policies, documenting those changes; and partner with the HR Manager to communicate updates company\-wide.
* Serve as Floor Warden and lead workplace safety and emergency preparedness initiatives, including participation in annual property management safety inspections.
* Partner with the HR Manager to support and track completion of required compliance and safety trainings, such as emergency notification systems, building security protocols, and cybersecurity awareness.
* Oversee vendor management (with executive oversight) \- including new\-vendor onboarding, contract maintenance and renewal (with price and service comparisons against alternative vendors), and invoice review and approval.
* Administer the corporate credit card program (in partnership with the CFO).
* Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding processes in partnership with HR and IT.
* Provide high\-level administrative support to partners and executives, including coordination of priorities, deadlines, deliverables, and meeting calendars.
* Participate in recurring HR/Office Operations meetings and help maintain the annual operations and compliance calendar.
* Provide training, delegation, and oversight to the administrative team to ensure consistent execution of office management standards.

**Employee Engagement**

* Plan and lead initiatives that strengthen company culture, morale, and connectivity across the firm.
* Partner with the HR Manager to recognize employee milestones, such as work anniversaries.
* Manage corporate programs and professional memberships/affiliations (e.g., sports partnerships, industry organizations) that support employee engagement and community involvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for staff on office\-related needs, fostering a welcoming and responsive workplace culture.

**Event Planning**

* Plan and execute company\-wide events, including quarterly all\-employee meetings, annual volunteer day, and holiday party.
* Coordinate logistics, budgets, and vendors for internal meetings and firm events.
* Manage event timelines, materials, and communications to ensure smooth execution from planning through follow\-up.

**Records Management**

* Maintain accurate, organized, and accessible company records and filing systems in accordance with firm standards, including version control.
* Manage and track corporate contracts, subscriptions, and third\-party agreements, monitoring renewal and expiration dates.
* Oversee maintenance of the company website and other digital repositories to ensure information remains current.
* Establish protocols for the retention, protection, and secure disposal of company records in compliance with applicable standards

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience with demonstrated proficiency in office management, in particular safety related programs (IIPP, WVPP, BCP)
