* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams, adapting to shifting needs independently.
* Professional, service\-oriented demeanor with strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Adobe, and document management systems; familiarity with office systems, visitor management, and work order platforms
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced office environment.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance.
* Ability to be present onsite at the office in San Francisco 5 days a week (Monday – Friday).
* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and climb stairs in an office space.
* Ability to use a computer and related equipment, often for multiple hours each day.
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

The Office Manager is responsible for managing the day\-to\-day operational workflow of an assigned office, ensuring files are handled efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with client Service Level Agreements (SLAs), department procedures, best practices, and divisional objectives. This position is responsible for monitoring office workflow, supporting appraiser production, identifying file delays or process gaps, and ensuring completed work products meet quality, documentation, and client\-specific handling requirements before final delivery.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Company**

ApprentiScope is the leading workforce\-management platform purpose\-built for Registered Apprenticeship programs, with customers ranging from Fortune 500 companies to state governments. Our core platform replaces labor\-intensive manual processes, enabling these organizations to scale their programs, reduce compliance burden, and generate measurable outcomes. As AI expansion and energy infrastructure modernization make the skilled trades an ever\-increasing national priority, that demand is accelerating, and ApprentiScope is positioned to define the category.

**Role Overview**

Onboarding Specialists own every new customer's journey from signed contract to go\-live. You'll run our largest implementations end to end: building project plans, coordinating data migrations, standing up SSO, and guiding customer IT and security stakeholders through technical rollouts. At the same time, you'll build the scaled onboarding motion for our smaller customers: cohort kickoffs, group training, and self\-serve resources that cut time\-to\-launch without cutting quality. You're our first dedicated onboarding hire, which means you'll inherit a live queue of active implementations and build the system while running it. At go\-live, you hand each customer to a Customer Success Manager who owns the ongoing relationship, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to get every customer to that handoff quickly, configured correctly, and confident in the product. The role sits at the intersection of project management, technical configuration, and teaching.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Onboarding \& Implementation*

* Own new customer onboarding from contract signature to go\-live: build the project plan, set milestones, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver on schedule
* Run enterprise implementations end to end: SSO and identity setup (SAML, Microsoft Entra, Okta), data migration, security and IT coordination, and phased rollouts across programs and locations
* Configure each customer's environment around their program structure and compliance requirements, including RAPIDS workflows, coordinating internally on data migration and integrations
* Deliver role\-based training that makes program sponsors, administrators, and field staff self\-sufficient quickly
* Track time\-to\-launch and clear blockers proactively; no project stalls without a named owner and a next step

*Scaled Onboarding*

* Design and run the one\-to\-many motion for smaller customers: cohort kickoffs, live group training, and office hours
* Build the templates, guides, and self\-serve resources that reduce per\-customer onboarding hours every quarter
* Turn what you see in the field into a prioritized friction list for the product team: what should be self\-serve, what should be automated, what confuses customers

*Systems \& Handoffs*

* Define and enforce the go\-live gate: a completion checklist plus a first adoption milestone before any account moves to steady state
* Bring the account's CSM in at kickoff so every customer meets their long\-term owner on day one
* Own onboarding metrics and report them weekly: time\-to\-launch, active project count, go\-live rate, and aging on anything stalled
* Build the onboarding playbook (project templates, milestone plans, training curriculum) as an early member of a growing team

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* 4\+ years in implementation, onboarding, professional services, or technical project management at a B2B SaaS company
* Proven ability to run 10\+ concurrent implementations: multi\-stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, and on\-time delivery
* Hands\-on experience with technical implementation work: SSO and identity providers (SAML, Entra, Okta), data migration, and integrations, comfortable working directly with customer IT teams
* Experience running enterprise rollouts: security reviews, IT and procurement stakeholders, multi\-month timelines
* Experience building or running one\-to\-many onboarding: cohorts, webinars, templated implementations
* Comfort with data: tracking cycle times and capacity, maintaining CRM hygiene (we run on HubSpot)
* Aptitude for developing deep technical product knowledge (configuration, integrations, workflows) and learning a regulated domain: Registered Apprenticeship compliance
* Training and facilitation skill: can teach a room of field users or a C\-suite sponsor with equal clarity
* Writes documentation other people can actually run: project plans, status updates, playbooks

**Behavioral Traits**

* Structured operator: runs a dozen concurrent projects without letting details slip
* Finisher: allergic to stalled projects; drives every implementation to go\-live and closes every loop
* Builder: documents as they go and turns anything done twice into a template
* Proactive, not reactive: customers and teammates always know the status and the next step
* Boundary\-disciplined: protects the project plan, flags scope creep early, and hands off cleanly instead of holding on
* Composed under pressure: keeps priorities straight when timelines compress and multiple accounts need attention at once
* Intellectually curious: genuinely wants to master a complex, compliance\-driven product and domain

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance (Medical, Vision \& Dental)
* Educational, Bereavement \& Parental leave
* 20 days paid time off
* Work from home stipend

**Compensation**

* Salary Range: $80,000 \- $90,000
* Equity: significant early\-stage stock options

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Transitions of Care (TOC) is one of Devoted Medical's largest clinical programs, responsible for making sure thousands of Devoted members get home safely after a hospitalization. You'll be part of our interdisciplinary leadership team — alongside peer RN Managers and leaders from our Nurse Practitioner, Care Coordinator, and Associate disciplines — collaborating on day\-to\-day operations, patient care strategy, and the continuous improvement of our virtual care model. * Proven ability to drive clinical and operational outcomes through new initiatives and data\-informed strategies

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Campaign Delivery
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Triadex is a full\-service data analysis, direct marketing, and digital agency working with national name brands and multi\-unit franchises across restaurant, home services, after\-market, dental, and related industries. We provide customer analysis, segmentation, direct mail, digital advertising, and other high\-ROI campaigns, with performance metrics on every activity we perform. Our approach is highly consultative: we pair excellent service with cutting\-edge recommendations that drive sales.

**Role Summary**

The Senior Project Manager owns end\-to\-end delivery of campaigns across a portfolio of client accounts, from pre\-production through in\-home delivery. This is the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks \- and who spots the crack before anything falls through it.

Direct mail is unforgiving. Dates are real, print slots are finite, and a tracking code or store\-match error caught after release becomes an expensive problem. This role exists to make that never happen, and to make the process feel effortless from the client's side even when it isn't behind the scenes.

The Senior Project Manager is expected to operate with a high degree of independence: identifying gaps and risks early, pulling in the right internal people to resolve them, and driving issues to closure without waiting to be asked. Alongside campaign delivery, this role safeguards the financial hygiene of each program \- insertion orders issued, payments secured before release to print, invoicing accurate and on time.

This is a growth seat. We are looking for someone with the appetite and aptitude to expand their scope over time, into process ownership, mentorship of junior coordinators, and eventually broader operational or account leadership.

**Responsibilities**

**1\. Campaign Delivery Ownership**

* Own the delivery schedule and launch date for every campaign in an assigned portfolio, holding all parties — client, internal teams, and third\-party providers — accountable to their deadlines.

**2\. Proactive Problem Solving**

* Identify risks and gaps before they become delays: a missing approval, an unclear spec, a client deliverable trending late, a vendor going quiet.
* Diagnose the actual problem rather than escalating symptoms, and arrive at the conversation with a recommended path forward.
* Know the organization well enough to loop in the right internal partner quickly — Data Analytics, Creative, Print, Operations, Finance, or Digital Partners — and bring them the specific context they need to act.
* Escalate early and clearly when a date is genuinely at risk, with impact and options laid out.
* Solve the logistical problems that arise mid\-flight — distribution issues, delivery timing, address or targeting complications — and communicate their resolution proactively.

**3\. Quality Control**

* Own quality control for the portfolio, personally reviewing proofs for spelling, grammar, tracking codes, offer accuracy, and recipient\-versus\-mailed\-store logic before anything reaches the client.
* Verify job details against the job order before issuing to the print department, catching discrepancies at the point where they are still cheap to fix.
* Treat quality standards as something to strengthen, not just apply: build and refine checklists, and capture the lessons from near\-misses so they don't recur.
* Maintain complete, accurate documentation — signed IOs, approved proofs, and job records filed correctly in Dropbox.

**4\. Client Communication**

* Keep clients informed and confident across the full arc of a project, from insertion order through creative, production, and in\-home delivery.
* Communicate with precision: clear next steps, explicit owners, real dates, and no ambiguity about what is needed from whom.
* Facilitate and lead client\-facing calls on production status, timelines, and approvals.
* Deliver difficult news early and well — a timeline slip surfaced today with a plan attached is a manageable conversation; the same slip surfaced at launch is not.
* Manage client expectations actively so that what's promised and what's delivered stay aligned.

**5\. Production, Creative \& Vendor Coordination**

* Facilitate the creative process end to end: templates to the client, client assets received on schedule, and clean handoff to creative services for production preparation.
* Interface with the print department to manage production schedules and requirements, aligning client approvals to press timing.
* Plan and oversee distribution of direct mail pieces, ensuring timely arrival at destination.
* Interface with targeting vendors for list purchases where data team involvement isn't required.

**6\. Financial Hygiene \& Order Management**

* Issue insertion orders directly to clients and drive follow\-up to ensure payment is received per terms before programs release to print.
* Manage the invoicing process for assigned accounts, ensuring accurate and timely billing.
* Protect company cash flow by treating payment milestones with the same rigor as production milestones.

**7\. Process Improvement \& Team Contribution** ***(growth scope)***

* Identify friction in existing workflows and propose or implement better approaches — templates, SOPs, automations, checklists.
* Serve as a resource to junior coordinators, sharing knowledge and modeling standards; grow into formal mentorship as the team scales.
* Help onboard new team members into delivery processes and tools.

**Experience**

* 4–6\+ years in project management, campaign operations, production coordination, or account coordination, with demonstrated ownership of delivery outcomes.
* Direct mail, print production, or marketing agency experience strongly preferred; familiarity with print timelines, postal logistics, and proofing cycles is a significant advantage.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

**Attention to Detail**

* Exceptional accuracy

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst - SaaS Migration
jobs.description:
**About Sycle**



Sycle is a market\-leading global SaaS company with the mission of facilitating the delivery of better hearing to the world. Founded in 2001, we have grown to be the leading practice management solution for audiology (hearing care) providers, with more than 65% market share. The Sycle practice management solution frees up valuable time so our customers can grow their businesses through delivering high quality patient care and exceptional services that delight their customers. Small hearing care practices and some of the largest retailers utilize our software in 13 countries worldwide.



The Sycle team is 120 strong. We are headquartered in Lone Tree, Colorado with a large remote workforce across the US and Canada. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to help us build and deliver market\-leading tools that make a difference for our customers. Check out our job listings and apply! This role is open to candidates in Colorado, California, Oregon and Washington.


**Position Overview**



Sycle is seeking a highly analytical and technical **Technical Business Analyst** to partner directly with our Product Management team on a high\-stakes enterprise account. In this role, you will get deep into the technical weeds—investigating legacy software systems, analyzing complex workflows, mapping out data, and translating detailed findings into clear recommendations for engineering and client stakeholders.



This role is critical in helping a major enterprise client transition from a heavily customized, legacy system onto Sycle’s modern SaaS platform. You will serve as the engine behind workflow mapping and system investigation while keeping cross\-functional teams organized and delivery on schedule.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Systems \& Workflow Analysis:** Perform detailed mapping of clinical, ordering, purchasing, and operational workflows across both "as\-is" legacy environments and "to\-be" SaaS platform states.
* **Deep Data \& System Investigation:** Independently investigate complex technical problems, conduct deep data analysis, write database queries, establish KPIs, and analyze system behaviors with minimal guidance.
* **Scrum Facilitation \& Agile Delivery:** Own and facilitate key Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, and demos to ensure predictable team delivery.
* **Technical Documentation:** Author high\-quality documentation that bridges high\-level business goals and granular technical requirements, tailoring communication for both technical teams and client executives.
* **Project Ownership \& Organization:** Maintain project artifacts, track risks, dependencies, and decisions, and proactively collaborate with Engineering to obtain and validate updates.
* **AI\-Enabled Productivity:** Leverage modern AI tools to streamline research, documentation, data analysis, and daily workflows to accelerate delivery speed.
* **Client Engagement:** Participate directly in enterprise client meetings, providing clear, accurate, and timely updates on technical workstreams and process maps.


**Qualifications**


* **Healthcare / Clinical Workflow Domain Knowledge:** Strong preference for experience in audiology, clinical management, or allied healthcare domains (e.g., chiropractic, physical therapy) to quickly grasp complex patient and operational workflows.
* **Enterprise Client Experience:** Proven track record working directly on high\-touch enterprise accounts where priorities shift rapidly and stakeholder management is critical.
* **Technical Rigor:** Proven ability to dive into technical details, write queries, review system architecture, and understand data models without needing constant engineering support.
* **High Adaptability \& Stress Management:** Strong emotional intelligence and resilience when navigating ambiguity, tight deadlines, client pressure, and shifting product priorities.
* **Strong Agile / Scrum Skills:** Hands\-on experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing project deliverables in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Excellent Communication:** Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear prose and concise client updates.


**Benefits**


* Medical, Dental, and Vision: Sycle pays employee\-only premiums at 100% for base plans.
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA): Pre\-tax options for Health ($3,400/yr) and Dependent Care ($7,500/yr).
* Life \& Disability: Voluntary Life/AD\&D; Short\-Term (60% up to $2,000/week) and Long\-Term (60% up to $7,500/month) Disability.
* 401(k) with Matching: 100% match on the first 3% of salary deferrals, plus 50% match on the next 2%—with no vesting schedule.
* Time Off: Paid holidays (\~14 days), 12 vacation days, 4 personal days, and 9 sick days.
* Perks: $50/month internet stipend and tuition reimbursement.


**How to Apply**



To apply, please submit your resume. If you’re going to submit a cover letter please focus on how your previous experience relates to this role and why you would be a good fit. Please include your LinkedIn profile in both your resume and in the designated application field.


**Compensation Note:** Salary ranges reflect our national pay band. Offers are determined based on the successful candidate's geographic location, local cost of living, and experience.

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. **A Culture of Excellence**


When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

**United States**

* Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
#### **About the Role**


At Xtremepush, we enable companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships by delivering exceptional technology, expertise, and customer service. As a leading provider of customer engagement solutions, our mission is to empower businesses to create meaningful, personalised experiences for their audiences.  

  

Due to rapid growth, we’re seeking an Account Manager to join our high\-performing team. In this role, you will be pivotal in fostering long\-term, trusted partnerships with some of our most valuable customers. By driving revenue retention and growth through relationship building, cross\-selling, and upselling, you’ll directly contribute to our company’s success.  

  

As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers achieve exceptional outcomes through our platform. By leveraging your expertise and interpersonal skills, you’ll help them realise the full value of their investment, fostering product adoption, expansion, and retention.  

  

This is a hybrid role. \#LI\-Hybrid

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Account Management \& Relationship Development:*** Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
* Build and nurture long\-lasting client relationships, maintaining regular and proactive communication.
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to discuss performance, align on strategic goals, and plan upcoming initiatives.
* Cultivate trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

**Business Development:*** Identify and present opportunities for cross\-selling and upselling.
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements.

**Reporting \& Operations:*** Manage client interactions and track progress meticulously using HubSpot.
* Prepare and present detailed account status reports.
* Forecast and track critical account metrics, such as sales performance and annual revenue projections.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end management of RFPs, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.

**Client Partnership:*** Act as a client advocate, ensuring their needs and feedback are effectively communicated across teams.
* Collaborate with internal departments to develop and implement strategies that drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Address client concerns promptly and escalate complex issues as necessary.
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of solutions that align with customer objectives.

#### **Your Experience and Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in an Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Sales Account Manager, Customer Success Manager or relevant role
* Have at least 2 years experience in a tech / SaaS company
* Experience working in the sports, betting and gaming industry
* Demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation, including executive and C\-level
* Experience delivering client\-focused solutions to customer needs
* Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
* Excellent listening, negotiation and presentation abilities
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Familiar with SaaS customer management or have a background in data with a flair for client communication and understand consumer behaviour is desirable
* Additional language is desirable

#### **Location**


This is a hybrid role based in North America. \#LI\-Hybrid

#### **About us**


Headquartered in Ireland with offices in the UK and US, Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built\-in CDP. It enables high\-velocity companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships through personalised, relevant, and timely communication. With a true single customer view at its core, Xtremepush provides actionable customer intelligence that drives engagement, conversion, and revenue across all channels, while putting customer retention first.  

  

*At Xtremepush, we believe that diversity adds incredible value to our teams, our products, and our culture. We don’t just accept differences, we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our mission by ensuring that our place can be anyone’s place regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.*

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
Total Expert is the Customer Operating System for financial services. Our purpose\-built platform combines a system of context with a system of action that enables humans and AI Assistants to engage in the moments that matter and earn customers for life. Since 2016 Total Expert has enabled more than seven trillion dollars of funded loan volume.

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) at Total Expert is a trusted partner to our financial services customers, helping them maximize the value of the platform through strategic guidance, technical enablement, and ongoing optimization. TAMs serve by combining product expertise with a deep understanding of customer goals, business context, and technology landscape.



This role bridges the gap between strategic vision and practical execution, delivering consistent, high\-quality engagements that are grounded in best\-practices that will drive adoption, operational efficiency, and measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate brings a proactive, service\-minded approach and is energized by the opportunity to help customers make critical financial decisions that shape their lives.


***For candidates based in the Dallas, TX or Minneapolis, MN area, the position follows a hybrid schedule with 3 on\-site days per week. This position would be remote for qualifying candidates residing outside of those areas.***


**What you’ll be doing:**



Feature Adoption \& Platform Strategy


* Be the technical expert on customer use cases, configuration and tech stack
* Deliver structured, outcome\-focused engagements that drive platform usage and customer value
* Identify and guide expansion and optimization opportunities as customer needs evolve
* Conduct usage reviews and platform audits to maximize ROI/value
* Lead strategic conversations with Customer to align business objectives with platform execution
* Provide actionable recommendations based on data insights, technical design, and industry best practices, taking said action on behalf of the customer, where possible
* Document the project, including requirements, actions, outcomes and ROI\-related deliverables


Stakeholder Collaboration \& Advocacy


* Partner with CSMs and Customers to build mutually agreed\-upon success plans that drive high\-value engagements, resulting in retention and growth
* Advocate internally for customer needs and serve as a voice to Product and Engineering teams
* Participate in strategic planning, roadmap discussions, and Executive Business Reviews
* Maintain detailed records of account activity and engagement history in CS tools


Internal Enablement \& Continuous Improvement


* Share field insights, scalable solutions, and best practices across the organization
* Contribute to improving delivery playbooks, engagement models, and consulting frameworks
* Help refine internal processes to ensure TAM activities are efficient, impactful, and measurable
* Occasional travel may be required for strategic customer engagements


**What we are looking for:**


* Ability to operate independently with a proactive, customer\-first mindset
* Bias for action and urgency
* Passion for helping organizations adopt technology and achieve measurable success
* Experience working with multi\-stakeholder, enterprise accounts in complex industries
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills—capable of translating strategy into action
* Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities within a dynamic environment
* Excellent organization, time management, and documentation skills
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and process documentation


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* 3\+ years in a Technical Account Management, Implementation, or Customer Success role
* Experience supporting financial institutions, mortgage lenders, or fintech companies
* Familiarity with Mortgage Tech (LOS, POS, PPE, CRM), APIs, BI tools, and data integration models
* Background in a Saas billable utilization framework, delivering structured customer engagements with measurable outcomes


**Compensation/Benefits:** The anticipated base salary range for this role is $85,000 \- $95,000 annually. Final total compensation offered is dependent upon the selected individual's qualifications and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on company performance and other factors. As an employee of the company, you will be eligible to participate in the Employee Stock Option Plan. Total Expert offers a competitive range of benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA (Health Savings Account), FSA (Flexible Spending Accounts), company paid Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, Flexible Time\-Off (FTO), Paid Parental Leave, and 401(k) with employer match.

  

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.***



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager, Full-time)
jobs.description:
**Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager)**
===============================================

**Full\-time \| Remote****Who We Are**
--------------


Prepory is a premier college admissions counseling company. Our innovative, holistic approach is reshaping how students apply to college, find their fit, and earn admission to their dream schools. We've guided more than 20,000 students across 80\+ countries, and we routinely help our students earn admission to the nation's most selective colleges and universities.  

Through our college admissions practice, we work one\-on\-one with students from as early as 8th grade, helping them build an intentional extracurricular profile, craft compelling essays, and navigate every step of the application process. We hold ourselves to an excellent record of success by gearing our services to genuinely counsel the students, families, and institutions we serve.**About This Role**
-------------------


The Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager) is the person our parents hear from most. You'll own the relationship between Prepory and the parents and guardians of the students we serve, from the orientation calls through final admissions decisions, and you'll make sure the experience a family signed up for is the experience they actually get.  

This is a client\-facing, relationship\-driven role. You'll run new student orientations and parent check\-in meetings, serve as the escalation point when a family's expectations and a coach's approach fall out of alignment, and mentor our college admissions coaches on how to navigate hard conversations and complicated family dynamics. When a family is ready to add programming or re\-enroll for another year, you'll be the person they trust enough to ask.  

You'll also maintain a cohort of up to 15 students. That caseload is deliberately small, because the majority of your hours belong to client success. Coaching a few students keeps you close to the advising experience you represent to parents every day.  

You'll report to our Client Success Director and work alongside our Program Directors, Program Managers, Enrollment team, and coaching team. **What You'll Do**

### **Own the family relationship**

* Conduct new student orientation sessions that set clear expectations for the program and each family's role in it.
* Run parent check\-in meetings alongside the student's coach, translating student progress into terms families understand and can act on.
* Communicate proactively with parents and guardians so concerns surface early, while there's still time to solve them.
* Serve as the point of escalation for families whose expectations, needs, or dynamics call for a steadier hand, and know when to bring in the Client Success Director.
* Handle difficult conversations with disappointed or anxious families directly, calmly, and with a solutions\-oriented attitude.

### **Support and protect the coaching relationship**

* Serve as the point of contact and escalation for college admissions coaches navigating client concerns, expectations, and family dynamics.
* Mentor coaches on client communication, individualized student needs, and the situations that don't have a playbook.
* Collaborate with coaches and program leadership to adjust programming when a student's needs change.

### **Grow the relationship**

* Recognize when a family is ready for more, and introduce the Prepory programming that fits: college tours, UK admissions support, graduate and professional school admissions, and enrichment and research planning.
* Own re\-enrollments for the families you serve, and carry the commercial conversation with the same care you bring to every other conversation.
* Champion referral and review strategies, including mentoring coaches on leveraging their relationship with families to drive positive reviews and referrals to friends and family.

### **Coach a cohort of up to 15 students**

* Conduct regular one\-on\-one advising sessions with your students, from profile building through final decisions.
* Advise students through the writing process for personal statements, supplemental essays, and résumés, providing meaningful, actionable feedback.
* Track each student's deadlines and assign tasks between sessions to keep them on pace.
* Help students research and build a balanced college list that reflects their academic and professional interests.

 **What You Bring**

* Admissions knowledge you can draw on in real time. You'll be on live calls with families who ask hard, specific questions. You need to answer most of them with confidence, and recognize the rest quickly enough to say you'll follow up rather than guess.
* Composure with any family in the room. Orientations and check\-ins put you in front of every kind of parent, from the entirely hands\-off to the deeply anxious.
* Real comfort with the commercial side of the work. We are looking for someone who is excited when a conversation turns to renewals, add\-on programming, or enrolling a second child, and who treats it as the natural extension of a relationship they've earned.
* Availability to work at least one evening per week and 12 Saturdays or Sundays per year.
* Impeccable listening, speaking, writing, and grammar skills, along with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-moving environment, including peak season, when orientations, check\-ins, and application deadlines all land at once.

**Qualifications of Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------------------------

* Graduated from a selective or highly\-selective college or university (top\-50 national university or top\-20 liberal arts college preferred).
* Three or more years of experience in college admissions, admissions consulting, or a closely related field. Experience inside an admissions office is a strong plus.
* Detailed, current knowledge of the U.S. college admissions process, and a willingness to stay current

jobs.description:
**Who we are**



At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.



Our dedication to remote\-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.  

.


**Hiring and how we work**



We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!



Also, while we are a remote\-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad\-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off\-sites or customer meetings.  

.

**See yourself at Twilio**



Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Account Manager


**About the job**



Twilio is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager who is going to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers. As a designated TAM you will be supporting customers during **Eastern hours (9am to 6pm ET)** and working on the cases created by customers and resolving complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far\-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture. The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime. You are able to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency. There will also be the potential need to volunteer for holiday coverage on a stipend basis.


**Responsibilities**



In this role, you’ll:


* Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
* Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far\-reaching consequences.
* Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
* Understanding customer trends, analyzing patterns, driving betterments and reporting what you observe to the management team in order to better improve our support process is a key part of the role.


**Qualifications**



Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!


* **Required:**

jobs.title: Member Support Associate
jobs.description:
What this job is

We deliver medically tailored meals to people on Medi\-Cal — many of them older, sick, or managing diabetes, kidney disease, or heart failure. Food shows up at their door because a doctor said they need it.

When something goes wrong, they call us. That's you.

About 28 people a day reach out. Most of it is:

\- "My food never came."

\- "I need to change my meals."

\- "I'm moving — here's my new address."

\- "Can you cancel?" or "Can you pause for two weeks?"

\- "Am I still eligible?"

You answer them, fix what you can, and hand off what you can't. You work from a queue on a screen; every conversation is tracked so nothing gets lost.

What we actually need

Not a degree. Not experience. We've written this job for someone who hasn't had a job like it before.

\- You show up. Every shift, on time. This is most of it.

\- You can write a clear sentence. Short, kind, no jargon. Many members read at a basic level, and some read in Spanish.

\- You stay calm when someone is upset. A person whose food didn't arrive isn't angry at you. Sometimes they're scared.

\- You ask when you don't know. Guessing about someone's medical care is the one thing we won't tolerate. Saying "let me find out" is always the right answer.

\- You keep a confidence. You'll see people's health information. It stays at work — that's the law, and we'll train you on exactly what it means.

Bilingual English/Spanish is a real advantage and we'll pay for it.

What you'll learn

This is a job where you find out whether healthcare is for you.

In six months you'll understand how Medi\-Cal works, how a referral becomes a delivery, and how to talk to a clinic. People who start here move into intake, dietitian support, operations, or account management. Some go back to school knowing what they want to study. That's a fine outcome.

The honest parts

\- It's a screen and a phone, most of the day.

\- Some calls are sad. People are sick, and occasionally a member dies. We'll talk about that before you start, not after.

\- You'll be trained on privacy rules that are strict and non\-negotiable, because the consequences for getting them wrong are real.

To apply

Tell us about a time you fixed something for someone. Any context — a job, school, family. Two paragraphs is plenty. No cover letter format, no buzzwords.

Pay: From $16\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Operations Analyst (Finance)
jobs.description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early\-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.



Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end\-to\-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI\-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.



This position is 100% remote in Latin America.


**About the Role**
------------------



We’re looking for an Operations Analyst (Finance) to join Able’s growing Operations function and work closely with our Head of Finance. This is a hands\-on role with two connected areas of ownership: finance execution and business insights. You’ll help keep the financial side of the business running reliably, from payroll and expenses to monthly close support, while also building the reporting and dashboards leadership needs to make better decisions.  

  

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both getting the numbers right and figuring out what the numbers are telling us. You’ll have the opportunity to build processes, improve systems, and establish reporting capabilities that don’t exist today.

  

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------


### **Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities**


### **Finance Operations**


* Own payroll execution across LATAM and US systems, including contractor payments and payroll reconciliation.
* Manage employee expenses, corporate cards, receipts, approvals, and reimbursements.
* Support the monthly close process through journal entries, reconciliations, invoice tracking, and accounts receivable follow\-up.
* Maintain accurate, clean, and reconciled financial data across relevant systems.
* Partner with the Head of Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and ad hoc financial analysis.
* Identify discrepancies and investigate issues until the underlying cause is understood and resolved.

### **Data \& Business Insights**


* Build and maintain Able’s leadership dashboard, covering key business metrics such as revenue, pipeline, retainer health, utilization, and cash.
* Establish recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting for the leadership team.
* Define and document business metrics so teams are working from consistent definitions and data.
* Provide ad hoc analysis to support strategic and operational decisions.
* Monitor data quality across systems such as HubSpot or Attio, Deel, and Greenhouse, and coordinate resolution of issues when they arise.
* Turn fragmented data into clear, actionable insights for leadership and other stakeholders.


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* 3–6 years of experience in finance operations, financial analysis, business operations, or a related analytical role, ideally within a growing company.
* Hands\-on experience with payroll, expense management, and monthly financial close processes.
* Strong analytical skills and advanced spreadsheet proficiency.
* Experience working with SQL and/or business intelligence tools such as Metabase, Looker Studio, or similar.
* Experience building dashboards, reports, or analyses for leadership audiences.
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of comfort working with financial data.
* Familiarity with tools such as Deel, Justworks, HubSpot, Attio, Greenhouse, or comparable systems.
* Ability to communicate clearly and confidently with both finance and non\-finance stakeholders.
* Strong ownership and the ability to manage work independently in a growing, evolving environment.

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience supporting both US and LATAM payroll or finance operations.
* Experience working in a startup, services business, or other lean operating environment.
* Experience establishing reporting processes or analytics capabilities from scratch.
* Experience with financial planning, forecasting, or budgeting.
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar as part of your day\-to\-day work.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------



We’re looking for someone who brings more than technical skills. The right person for this role is:


* **AI\-fluent.** You already use AI tools in your day\-to\-day work to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks, draft materials, and work more efficiently.
* **A builder.** You’re comfortable creating processes and systems where there isn’t a playbook yet. You’d rather ship a useful first version and improve it than wait for perfection.
* **Detail\-oriented.** You understand that financial operations require precision. When the numbers don’t tie, you want to know why.
* **A clear communicator.** You surface problems early, ask questions when something is unclear, and communicate what you know — and what you don’t.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** Able is growing and evolving quickly. You’ll help shape the processes and systems you’ll eventually own.


Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge\-sharing, and hands\-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.


**This position is 100% remote in Latin America. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement.**



As a team member, you can expect:


* To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.
* Payments made in USD.
* 18 days of PTO

**Digital Ad Operations Specialist, Level 2**  


The **Digital Ad Operations Specialist, Level 2**, joins a team responsible for Farm Journal digital campaigns from conception to completion. This role manages both programmatic and paid social campaigns, with an intermediate understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem and Farm Journal’s portfolio of brands. The Level 2 specialist executes campaigns involving 5 or more ad groups across multiple platforms with limited mistakes, and proactively communicates campaign insights and performance recommendations without waiting to be prompted by leadership.  


The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and growing in their ability to troubleshoot underperforming campaigns, apply audience strategy, and support team leads on escalated matters. At this level, team members are expected to accurately launch 75\-100 new campaigns per month while continuing to manage previously live campaigns, including medium\-complexity campaigns defined by multiple flights, audience intersections, creative breakouts, or pixel\-focused setups.  


**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Proactively communicate campaign insights, performance updates, and basic optimization recommendations to team leads and Client Success Managers (CSMs) without being prompted.
* Support team leads on all escalated matters within assigned account lists.

**Role Overview**
=================



We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end\-to\-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit\-out, and live, steady\-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well\-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual\-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross\-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.


**What You'll Do**
==================


**Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership**


* Own the end\-to\-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit\-out, and steady\-state operations.
* Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.
* Track and drive closure of cross\-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go\-live.
* Identify and escalate risks to go\-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.


**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.

* Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.
* Track hardware intake, rack\-and\-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.
* Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.
* Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.
* Take part in regular cross\-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.
* Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.


**Local Day Two Operations Readiness**


* Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.
* Create and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational processes required for local Operations teams to run the site post\-handover.
* Create the operational site tool bill of materials (BOM) required for local Operations teams to maintain the site post\-handover.
* Verify the spare parts bill of materials (BOM) is complete and in place ahead of Day 2 handover.
* Facilitate structured knowledge transfer and handover documentation from Construction, Network, and Compute teams to local Operations teams.
* Confirm monitoring, ticketing, and ITSM processes are validated and operating before a site is handed to local Operations.
* Act as an escalation point for local Operations teams during the early post\-handover period to smooth the transition.


**Reliability, Safety \& Compliance**


* Define and enforce Day 2 readiness criteria that a site must meet before transitioning to local Operations ownership.
* Facilitate root\-cause analysis for transition delays or gaps surfaced during handover, and drive remediation across teams.

* Support certification and audit readiness (ISO 27001, ISO 22237, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 22301\) ahead of go\-live.


**Vendor \& Supplier Coordination**

* Track vendor commitments and SLAs relevant to the transition window, and escalate delays that put go\-live at risk.
* Coordinate with the Supply Chain team to align hardware intake and staging with the transition schedule.


**Monitoring, Reporting \& Analytics**


* Track KPIs and KRIs for the Day 0 to Day 2 transition process (time to transition, readiness checklist completion rate, post\-handover incident rate, etc.).
* Build and maintain dashboards that track transition status across your assigned site pipeline for all stakeholder teams.
* Produce regular reports for senior leadership on transition status, risks, and blockers.
* Use data\-driven insights to identify systemic bottlenecks in the Day 0 to Day 2 process and drive continuous improvement.

**About You**
=============


**Experience \& Background**


* 3\-8 years of experience in data centre operations, program/project management, or infrastructure deployment at scale.
* Proven track record coordinating the transition of new sites into live operations across construction, network, compute, and operations functions.
* Experience operating in a matrixed environment, influencing outcomes without direct authority over every stakeholder team.
* Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent site transitions in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment.

**Technical Knowledge \& Expertise**

### **The Role**



As a **Design Program Manager** at Everlaw, you'll establish the operating system for our growing product design team, bringing structure, visibility, and predictability to how we design AI\-powered litigation tools. As our first dedicated Design Program Manager, you'll absorb operational friction and cross\-functional complexity so product designers can focus entirely on craft, quality, and solving complex user workflows.


**This is a full\-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**


#### **What you'll do**


* Own the design operating model for planning and delivery — define how design work is estimated, sequenced, and handed off, and maintain the system that makes dependencies and timeline risk visible before they become escalations.
* Define design readiness criteria and coordinate pre\-launch quality reviews to ensure shipped features meet high standards for craft, responsiveness, accessibility, and edge cases.
* Own the working interfaces between Design, Product Management, Engineering, User Research, and Technical Writing — define how scope is agreed, how dependencies are tracked, and where conflicts get decided, so those questions have a standing answer instead of being renegotiated per project.
* Build and champion lightweight design operations rhythms, frameworks, and templates—such as design briefs and critique structures—to streamline team workflows.
* Manage design resourcing and bandwidth tracking to inform staffing decisions, highlight capacity constraints, and help leadership plan for future team growth.
* Own how design's work is represented to the business — build and maintain the reporting layer (capacity, throughput, readiness) that lets product and executive leadership plan against design, rather than assembling narrative updates each cycle.

#### **About You**


* You have at least 5 years of experience in Design Program Management or Design Operations supporting product design teams in complex, enterprise B2B SaaS or data\-heavy environments.
* You excel at balancing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, steering teams through ambiguity with structure, clear prioritization, and empathy.
* You've built and scaled lightweight design operations frameworks, delivery plans, and resource tracking processes without stifling creative momentum.
* You bring excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to translate design progress and complex trade\-offs into business\-relevant narratives for leadership.
* You bring a strong understanding of user\-centered design methodologies, modern UX workflows, and tools like Figma.
* You have experience working with project tracking tools like Jira or emerging AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Design).
* You operate with a low\-ego, highly collaborative style, finding genuine fulfillment in making design teams visible and successful.
* You are authorized to work in the United States without restrictions. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring F\-1 visas, including OPT, for this role.


Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.


### **The Team — Product**



The Product team shapes products used by everyone from document reviewers and corporate teams to government attorneys and law firm partners, each with distinct needs across a broad and complex domain. The team brings together user insight, market context, business priorities, design, and technical feasibility to decide what Everlaw builds and why. This work turns deeply capable technology into intuitive experiences and helps define the next era of legal work.


### **Total Rewards \& Benefits**



The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $178,000\. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.


#### **Health \& well\-being**


* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company\-sponsored life and disability insurance

#### **Financial rewards**


* Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long\-term growth
* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

#### **Growth \& everyday perks**


* 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company\-wide days off) per year
* Annual allocation for learning \& development and relevant professional membership dues
* Hybrid work with regular work\-from\-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company\-wide events in our offices

### **About Everlaw**



When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

new_jobs.title: Self-Perform Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
***Collaborative people. Progressive builders.***


Consistently recognized as a best workplace, and for our commitment to safety, sustainability, and community partnerships, BNBuilders hires the very best in the construction industry and strives to create an environment that encourages innovation, responsibility, and client satisfaction. If you are looking to be a part of an open, supportive team and receive exciting challenges that promote personal and professional growth, look no further than BNBuilders!

 **JOB SUMMARY:**


The Self\-Perform Project Manager provides operational and financial management support for the self\-perform projects. This role will be the main liaison between the Drywall and General Contractor Project Teams throughout the duration of the project(s).

 **SALARY RANGE:** $140,000 \- $180,000 annually

 **BENEFITS:**

* Group medical, vision, and dental insurance, including a choice of two benefit plans \- a PPO plan and a High Deductible/ Health Savings Account plan with company contribution to HSA.
* Company\-paid short and long\-term disability plans, group life insurance, and AD\&D plans.
* Untracked/unmeasured vacation.
* Sick leave accrued at 1 hour of sick leave for every 30 hours worked with an annual carryover of 80 hours.
* 9 paid holidays each year.
* Paid parental leave.
* Annual discretionary bonus based on company profitability and your manager's assessment of your performance.
* A 401(k) savings plan under which BNB matches the first 3 percent of your deferral with a 100% match and the next two percent with a 50% match for a total matching contribution of 4% of your pay. You are immediately 100% vested in all contributions (including BNB match). We provide both traditional (pre\-tax) and Roth (post\-tax) contribution options.
* We are proud to be an employee\-owned company. This means you get an ownership stake in BNB through a benefit called an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). It's 100% company\-funded and is invested in BNBuilders stock. You can participate in this long\-term plan after you complete 1 year of service (with at least 1,000 hours).
* Vehicle/Vehicle allowance, fuel card, and toll pass.

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Exercise general supervision of multiple job sites to monitor and manage projects during each phase of construction; including but not limited to pre\-construction, construction, closeout, and post\-construction.
* Create and execute project work plans and makes appropriate revisions to meet changing needs.
* Identify resources needed and assigns individual responsibilities.
* Manage day\-to\-day operation aspects of a project and scope.
* Prepare and manage change orders.
* Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately.
* Develop cost\-effective plans and schedules for completion of projects following a logical pattern for utilization of resources.
* Responsible for ensuring that construction activities move according to predetermined schedule and project profitability forecast, monitoring the progress of construction activities on a regular basis and holding regular status meetings.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure all pertinent information is provided; proactive communication with field leaders on bid productions, RFI’s, and scope changes and maintains consistent communication throughout the project.
* Maintain strict adherence to the budgetary guidelines, quality, and safety standards.
* Proactively raise issues with the Team that may prevent flow and production.
* Meet with the Team as required to review change orders, roadblocks, production tracking, RFI’s, etc.
* Assist and mediate issues in the field. Document solutions, agreements and/or direction.
* Project accounting functions including managing the budget and preparing monthly project cost projections.
* Submit monthly billings for self\-performs scopes.
* Approve and reconcile vendor invoices.
* Negotiate and advocate for safety, quality, and production.
* Promote strong team morale.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\+ years or more of experience in the commercial drywall industry.
* Proven ability to coach and develop others and possess a team player mentality.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Detail\-oriented, deadline/goal\-driven.
* Ability to communicate effectively with team and clients.

  



**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:***The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

  

Capable of traversing over construction\-type terrain when under development; moving through the construction site and the materials in place for use on the site; climbing ladders and temporary stairways; conducting visual inspections of quality of construction and materials being used in construction. Conduct jobsite walks to ensure successful project completion. Conduct jobsite walks to identify and eliminate safety hazards.

 **WORK ENVIRONMENT:***The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

  

BNB believes in collaboration, team\-building, and a strong supervisor/employee relationship. To accomplish this, the duties of this role are not performed in a remote capacity, and we expect that all employees will complete work in an office/job site setting.

  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at the job site. The noise level in the work environment and job site can be loud.

new_jobs.title: Corporate Real Estate Transaction Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role:**  

We are seeking a strategic and highly execution\-oriented Corporate Real Estate Transaction Program Manager to support a fast\-growing tech company. In this role, you will program manage the lifecycle of real estate leasing transactions, from initial market analysis through technical due diligence and executive approvals to lease execution and provide day\-to\-day support to the transaction team.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

Program Leadership \& Initial Search Strategy
  
**Strategic Market Search:** Define and prepare project requirement statements and geographic search boundaries.
  
**Geospatial Tracking:** Track viable options and manage building information using mapping tools and spreadsheets.
  
**Market Evaluation:** Direct the gathering of local market intelligence reports to identify viable market opportunities.
  
Market Tours and Technical Due Diligence
  
**Market Tour Coordination:** Orchestrate property tours for stakeholders and consultants.
  
**Site Feasibility:** Gather property data points including ingress/egress, power availability, site plans, structural floor plans, critical technical specifications and zoning information.
  
Deal Underwriting \& Negotiating Process
  
**Negotiation Process Tracking:** Monitor offer letter exchanges through lease execution.
  
**Document Management:** Organize due diligence and transaction documents.
  
**Financial Analysis:** Evaluate building options and continuously update financial models across negotiation cycles.
  
Executive Approval \& Transaction Closing
  
**Executive Approval Decks:** Assist with committee approval decks containing business\-critical underwriting, maps and photos, and operational building facts (e.g., square footage, lease commencement dates, technical specifications).
  
**Lease Verification:** Cross\-verify that final agreed business terms are accurately translated into leases.
  
**Cross\-Functional Governance:** Delegate specialized lease clauses to internal stakeholders for their respective reviews.
  
**Risk Auditing:** Track real\-time program milestones and actively flag missing due diligence tasks.
  
  

**What You’ll Need:**  

Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, preferred. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  
2\-5 years of relevant experience, corporate real estate program management or senior transaction advisory experience, preferred.
  
Ability to use existing procedures to solve standard problems.
  
Experience with analyzing information and standard practices to make judgments.
  
In\-depth capability with Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Docs, My Maps), workflow management and messaging tools. MS Office.
  
Organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
  
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants. Applicant AI Use Disclosure
  
We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.
  
  

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Real Estate Transaction Program Manager position is $75,000 annually or ($36\.06 per hour) and the maximum salary for the Real Estate Transaction Program Manager position is $110,000 annually \[or $52\.89 per hour]. Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

**Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.**



More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it's because they are employed by a company that doesn't offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium\-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.



We're a high\-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.


**About the role**



Our Partnership Program is a key initiative for the company. The Partner Account Manager's primary duty is to engage, build and develop Human Interest's key accounts and growth opportunities. We're looking for a forward\-thinking, meticulously organized, and self\-motivated sales professional who can thrive in a fast\-paced environment. You'll accelerate our partner relationships to help us exponentially reach more small and medium businesses across the United States, which is essential to our growth. new_jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, corporate/internal communications, management consulting, Google Ads sales or sales enablement, or a related field.
* 3 years of project management experience working across cross\-functional teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating high\-level strategies into polished assets alongside creative partners, video producers, and agencies.
* Experience in, experimenting with and leveraging emerging AI tools to optimize daily workflows or enhance creative output.
* Sharp critical thinking and creative investigative skills to structure and resolve complex operational issues.
* Strong background in Google Ads products, sales tech, or market trends, with an active drive to simplify sellers' day\-to\-day workflows.
* Proven track record as a versatile all\-rounder managing multiple workflows and shifting priorities in changing environments.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Creative in Marketing, you bring visual, design, written and experiential acumen to Google products and services, presented across all major media, content, channels, and experiences. You have the ability to perform your role in a flexible, ever\-changing environment and must be open to new influences and inspiration. You will work with a deeply cross\-functional team and inspire a team of vendor partners by sharing ideas and developing effective solutions to generate multiple concepts supporting all forms of major media. You will be equally comfortable making; rolling up your sleeves and designing, mocking, writing, or prototyping; showing, not telling. Above all, you will inspire and lead by example by making the most of every opportunity to develop breakthrough creative, consistent with the Google Marketing brand, and be able to take and provide clear direction and creative feedback that pushes work forward.

As a Marketing and Communications Manager on the Google Compute Engine (GCE) Marketing team, you will be an all\-rounder combining structured thinking, compelling storytelling, and rapid execution. You will pivot seamlessly from drafting concise executive updates to creative seller\-facing narratives, high\-level strategy, or asset production (videos, templates). You will translate complex AI and product concepts into clear stories, thriving in ambiguity to address whatever issues come next.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $116000 \- $166000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

--------------------

* Craft beautifully written, punchy, and highly polished communications, executive updates, newsletters, and slide copy that make complex Ads products, sales training initiatives, and AI tools instantly understandable.
* Pivot fluidly between high\-level planning, operational execution, and creative copywriting as business priorities shift.
* Synthesize complex leadership discussions and data points into crisp action items, and design polished, narrative\-driven decks for high\-stakes executive discussions.
* Lead collaborative initiatives across global product, sales, and engineering teams, translating complex strategies into seller\-first framing.
