new_jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

The Office Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day operation of the office, firm\-wide administrative support, and coordination of office, safety, onboarding, and internal events. This role partners closely with the Executive Team, HR, Property Management, and external vendors to ensure a well\-run, organized, and welcoming workplace. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, discretion, and a proactive, service\-oriented mindset

**Key Responsibilities**

**Office Operations \& Compliance**

* Maintain full knowledge of and administer key compliance policies, including the Business Continuity Plan (BCP), Injury and Illness Prevention Program (IIPP), and Workplace Violence Prevention Plan (WVPP).
* Monitor regulatory changes in workplace safety; recommend and implement updates to internal policies, documenting those changes; and partner with the HR Manager to communicate updates company\-wide.
* Serve as Floor Warden and lead workplace safety and emergency preparedness initiatives, including participation in annual property management safety inspections.
* Partner with the HR Manager to support and track completion of required compliance and safety trainings, such as emergency notification systems, building security protocols, and cybersecurity awareness.
* Oversee vendor management (with executive oversight) \- including new\-vendor onboarding, contract maintenance and renewal (with price and service comparisons against alternative vendors), and invoice review and approval.
* Administer the corporate credit card program (in partnership with the CFO).
* Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding processes in partnership with HR and IT.
* Provide high\-level administrative support to partners and executives, including coordination of priorities, deadlines, deliverables, and meeting calendars.
* Participate in recurring HR/Office Operations meetings and help maintain the annual operations and compliance calendar.
* Provide training, delegation, and oversight to the administrative team to ensure consistent execution of office management standards.

**Employee Engagement**

* Plan and lead initiatives that strengthen company culture, morale, and connectivity across the firm.
* Partner with the HR Manager to recognize employee milestones, such as work anniversaries.
* Manage corporate programs and professional memberships/affiliations (e.g., sports partnerships, industry organizations) that support employee engagement and community involvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for staff on office\-related needs, fostering a welcoming and responsive workplace culture.

**Event Planning**

* Plan and execute company\-wide events, including quarterly all\-employee meetings, annual volunteer day, and holiday party.
* Coordinate logistics, budgets, and vendors for internal meetings and firm events.
* Manage event timelines, materials, and communications to ensure smooth execution from planning through follow\-up.

**Records Management**

* Maintain accurate, organized, and accessible company records and filing systems in accordance with firm standards, including version control.
* Manage and track corporate contracts, subscriptions, and third\-party agreements, monitoring renewal and expiration dates.
* Oversee maintenance of the company website and other digital repositories to ensure information remains current.
* Establish protocols for the retention, protection, and secure disposal of company records in compliance with applicable standards

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience with demonstrated proficiency in office management, in particular safety related programs (IIPP, WVPP, BCP)
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams, adapting to shifting needs independently.
* Professional, service\-oriented demeanor with strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Adobe, and document management systems; familiarity with office systems, visitor management, and work order platforms
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced office environment.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance.
* Ability to be present onsite at the office in San Francisco 5 days a week (Monday – Friday).
* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and climb stairs in an office space.
* Ability to use a computer and related equipment, often for multiple hours each day.
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

The Office Manager is responsible for managing the day\-to\-day operational workflow of an assigned office, ensuring files are handled efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with client Service Level Agreements (SLAs), department procedures, best practices, and divisional objectives. This role oversees the movement of work from assignment intake through appraiser handling, office review, and final return to the client.



The Office Manager plays a critical role in maintaining timely and professional client communication, ensuring diary updates, file notes, missing information requests, and client\-facing responses are completed accurately and within expected timelines. This position is responsible for monitoring office workflow, supporting appraiser production, identifying file delays or process gaps, and ensuring completed work products meet quality, documentation, and client\-specific handling requirements before final delivery.



The Office Manager also coordinates with Appraisers, Regional Field Managers, Operations leadership, Resource Management, Compliance, Training, and other support teams to maintain SLA adherence, resolve workflow issues, and support consistent execution of operational standards. The role requires strong organization, communication, follow\-through, and the ability to manage multiple file priorities while maintaining service quality and client responsiveness.

**Essential functions** (Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.)


* Assess and monitor open/pending assignments and new incoming assignments to facilitate the management of cycle time and appraiser productivity throughout the assignment process within an area or for specified key clients
* Utilize internal tools provided to optimally allocate available resources to ensure client service level expectations are met or exceeded. This includes but not limited to: Optimizer, WEBFMS, Capacity Planner, etc.
* Drive office and appraiser performance by providing guidance and feedback specific to client service level agreements to appraisers throughout the life cycle of an assignment, while keeping the client updated appropriately.
* Perform quality control on final work product by reviewing all assignment details to ensure estimate compliance, photo compliance, reporting compliance, and invoicing accuracy per Alacrity standards or specific client service level agreements.
* Ensure security, integrity, and confidentiality of data.
* Adherence to all company, federal and state rules, policies, and safety regulations
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* People management: An Office Unit Manager needs to have excellent people management skills, including the ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members to ensure that they are performing at their best and delivering high\-quality work.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: The ability to communicate effectively and build strong relationships with team members, clients, and stakeholders is crucial in this role.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making: The ability to identify and solve problems, make informed decisions quickly and under pressure, and to think creatively to find solutions to complex challenges are all critical competencies for this role.

new_jobs.description:
Business Analyst – VA Healthcare Technology

**Mid\-Level \| Federal Healthcare IT \| VistA Scheduling**

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a **Business Analyst** to join our team supporting a Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare technology program focused on **VistA Scheduling and Veteran access to care**.

In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of business operations and technology—partnering with VA stakeholders, product owners, clinical and scheduling SMEs, developers, and QA teams to understand user needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements.

This is a great opportunity for a mid\-level BA who enjoys digging into complex workflows, collaborating with technical teams, and seeing their work directly contribute to technology used in support of Veterans and VA healthcare operations.

**What You’ll Do**

* Gather, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
* Translate stakeholder needs into **user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, and functional requirements**.
* Analyze current and future workflows related to patient scheduling, clinic availability, appointment management, check\-in, cancellations, and rescheduling.
* Facilitate requirements sessions and collaborate with VA stakeholders, Product Owners, SMEs, developers, and testers.
* Support backlog refinement, story decomposition, sprint planning, demos, and other Agile activities.
* Identify requirements gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and potential impacts to existing functionality.
* Work with technical teams to understand application behavior, data, interfaces, integrations, configuration, and system dependencies.
* Support QA and UAT by developing scenarios, reviewing test cases, validating acceptance criteria, and helping troubleshoot defects.
* Assist with defect triage and production issue analysis by documenting expected vs. actual behavior and business impact.
* Maintain traceability between business requirements, development, testing, and releases.
* Support release readiness, documentation, demonstrations, and stakeholder communications.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **\*\*\*Active public trust clearance with the Veteran Affairs Department\*\*\***
* **3–5 years of experience** as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role supporting software development.
* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.

new_jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Company**

ApprentiScope is the leading workforce\-management platform purpose\-built for Registered Apprenticeship programs, with customers ranging from Fortune 500 companies to state governments. Our core platform replaces labor\-intensive manual processes, enabling these organizations to scale their programs, reduce compliance burden, and generate measurable outcomes. As AI expansion and energy infrastructure modernization make the skilled trades an ever\-increasing national priority, that demand is accelerating, and ApprentiScope is positioned to define the category.

**Role Overview**

Onboarding Specialists own every new customer's journey from signed contract to go\-live. You'll run our largest implementations end to end: building project plans, coordinating data migrations, standing up SSO, and guiding customer IT and security stakeholders through technical rollouts. At the same time, you'll build the scaled onboarding motion for our smaller customers: cohort kickoffs, group training, and self\-serve resources that cut time\-to\-launch without cutting quality. You're our first dedicated onboarding hire, which means you'll inherit a live queue of active implementations and build the system while running it. At go\-live, you hand each customer to a Customer Success Manager who owns the ongoing relationship, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to get every customer to that handoff quickly, configured correctly, and confident in the product. The role sits at the intersection of project management, technical configuration, and teaching.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Onboarding \& Implementation*

* Own new customer onboarding from contract signature to go\-live: build the project plan, set milestones, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver on schedule
* Run enterprise implementations end to end: SSO and identity setup (SAML, Microsoft Entra, Okta), data migration, security and IT coordination, and phased rollouts across programs and locations
* Configure each customer's environment around their program structure and compliance requirements, including RAPIDS workflows, coordinating internally on data migration and integrations
* Deliver role\-based training that makes program sponsors, administrators, and field staff self\-sufficient quickly
* Track time\-to\-launch and clear blockers proactively; no project stalls without a named owner and a next step

*Scaled Onboarding*

* Design and run the one\-to\-many motion for smaller customers: cohort kickoffs, live group training, and office hours
* Build the templates, guides, and self\-serve resources that reduce per\-customer onboarding hours every quarter
* Turn what you see in the field into a prioritized friction list for the product team: what should be self\-serve, what should be automated, what confuses customers

*Systems \& Handoffs*

* Define and enforce the go\-live gate: a completion checklist plus a first adoption milestone before any account moves to steady state
* Bring the account's CSM in at kickoff so every customer meets their long\-term owner on day one
* Own onboarding metrics and report them weekly: time\-to\-launch, active project count, go\-live rate, and aging on anything stalled
* Build the onboarding playbook (project templates, milestone plans, training curriculum) as an early member of a growing team

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* 4\+ years in implementation, onboarding, professional services, or technical project management at a B2B SaaS company
* Proven ability to run 10\+ concurrent implementations: multi\-stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, and on\-time delivery
* Hands\-on experience with technical implementation work: SSO and identity providers (SAML, Entra, Okta), data migration, and integrations, comfortable working directly with customer IT teams
* Experience running enterprise rollouts: security reviews, IT and procurement stakeholders, multi\-month timelines
* Experience building or running one\-to\-many onboarding: cohorts, webinars, templated implementations
* Comfort with data: tracking cycle times and capacity, maintaining CRM hygiene (we run on HubSpot)
* Aptitude for developing deep technical product knowledge (configuration, integrations, workflows) and learning a regulated domain: Registered Apprenticeship compliance
* Training and facilitation skill: can teach a room of field users or a C\-suite sponsor with equal clarity
* Writes documentation other people can actually run: project plans, status updates, playbooks

**Behavioral Traits**

* Structured operator: runs a dozen concurrent projects without letting details slip
* Finisher: allergic to stalled projects; drives every implementation to go\-live and closes every loop
* Builder: documents as they go and turns anything done twice into a template
* Proactive, not reactive: customers and teammates always know the status and the next step
* Boundary\-disciplined: protects the project plan, flags scope creep early, and hands off cleanly instead of holding on
* Composed under pressure: keeps priorities straight when timelines compress and multiple accounts need attention at once
* Intellectually curious: genuinely wants to master a complex, compliance\-driven product and domain

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance (Medical, Vision \& Dental)
* Educational, Bereavement \& Parental leave
* 20 days paid time off
* Work from home stipend

**Compensation**

* Salary Range: $80,000 \- $90,000
* Equity: significant early\-stage stock options

In this role, you will get deep into the technical weeds—investigating legacy software systems, analyzing complex workflows, mapping out data, and translating detailed findings into clear recommendations for engineering and client stakeholders.



This role is critical in helping a major enterprise client transition from a heavily customized, legacy system onto Sycle’s modern SaaS platform. You will serve as the engine behind workflow mapping and system investigation while keeping cross\-functional teams organized and delivery on schedule.

* **Systems \& Workflow Analysis:** Perform detailed mapping of clinical, ordering, purchasing, and operational workflows across both "as\-is" legacy environments and "to\-be" SaaS platform states.

* **Enterprise Client Experience:** Proven track record working directly on high\-touch enterprise accounts where priorities shift rapidly and stakeholder management is critical.

* Perks: $50/month internet stipend and tuition reimbursement.

To apply, please submit your resume. If you’re going to submit a cover letter please focus on how your previous experience relates to this role and why you would be a good fit. Please include your LinkedIn profile in both your resume and in the designated application field.


**Compensation Note:** Salary ranges reflect our national pay band. Offers are determined based on the successful candidate's geographic location, local cost of living, and experience.

#### **About the Role**


At Xtremepush, we enable companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships by delivering exceptional technology, expertise, and customer service. As a leading provider of customer engagement solutions, our mission is to empower businesses to create meaningful, personalised experiences for their audiences.  

  

Due to rapid growth, we’re seeking an Account Manager to join our high\-performing team. In this role, you will be pivotal in fostering long\-term, trusted partnerships with some of our most valuable customers. By driving revenue retention and growth through relationship building, cross\-selling, and upselling, you’ll directly contribute to our company’s success.  

  

As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers achieve exceptional outcomes through our platform. By leveraging your expertise and interpersonal skills, you’ll help them realise the full value of their investment, fostering product adoption, expansion, and retention.  

  

This is a hybrid role. \#LI\-Hybrid

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Account Management \& Relationship Development:*** Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
* Build and nurture long\-lasting client relationships, maintaining regular and proactive communication.
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to discuss performance, align on strategic goals, and plan upcoming initiatives.
* Cultivate trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

**Business Development:*** Identify and present opportunities for cross\-selling and upselling.
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements.

**Reporting \& Operations:*** Manage client interactions and track progress meticulously using HubSpot.
* Prepare and present detailed account status reports.
* Forecast and track critical account metrics, such as sales performance and annual revenue projections.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end management of RFPs, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.

**Client Partnership:*** Act as a client advocate, ensuring their needs and feedback are effectively communicated across teams.
* Collaborate with internal departments to develop and implement strategies that drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Address client concerns promptly and escalate complex issues as necessary.
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of solutions that align with customer objectives.

#### **Your Experience and Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in an Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Sales Account Manager, Customer Success Manager or relevant role
* Have at least 2 years experience in a tech / SaaS company
* Experience working in the sports, betting and gaming industry
* Demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation, including executive and C\-level
* Experience delivering client\-focused solutions to customer needs
* Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
* Excellent listening, negotiation and presentation abilities
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Familiar with SaaS customer management or have a background in data with a flair for client communication and understand consumer behaviour is desirable

This is a hybrid role based in North America. \#LI\-Hybrid

new_jobs.title: Member Support Associate
new_jobs.description:
What this job is

We deliver medically tailored meals to people on Medi\-Cal — many of them older, sick, or managing diabetes, kidney disease, or heart failure. Food shows up at their door because a doctor said they need it.

When something goes wrong, they call us. That's you.

About 28 people a day reach out. Most of it is:

\- "My food never came."

\- "I need to change my meals."

\- "I'm moving — here's my new address."

\- "Can you cancel?" or "Can you pause for two weeks?"

\- "Am I still eligible?"

You answer them, fix what you can, and hand off what you can't. You work from a queue on a screen; every conversation is tracked so nothing gets lost.

What we actually need

Not a degree. Not experience. We've written this job for someone who hasn't had a job like it before.

\- You show up. Every shift, on time. This is most of it.

\- You can write a clear sentence. Short, kind, no jargon. Many members read at a basic level, and some read in Spanish.

\- You stay calm when someone is upset. A person whose food didn't arrive isn't angry at you. Sometimes they're scared.

\- You ask when you don't know. Guessing about someone's medical care is the one thing we won't tolerate. Saying "let me find out" is always the right answer.

\- You keep a confidence. You'll see people's health information. It stays at work — that's the law, and we'll train you on exactly what it means.

Bilingual English/Spanish is a real advantage and we'll pay for it.

What you'll learn

This is a job where you find out whether healthcare is for you.

In six months you'll understand how Medi\-Cal works, how a referral becomes a delivery, and how to talk to a clinic. People who start here move into intake, dietitian support, operations, or account management. Some go back to school knowing what they want to study. That's a fine outcome.

The honest parts

\- It's a screen and a phone, most of the day.

\- Some calls are sad. People are sick, and occasionally a member dies. We'll talk about that before you start, not after.

\- You'll be trained on privacy rules that are strict and non\-negotiable, because the consequences for getting them wrong are real.

To apply

Tell us about a time you fixed something for someone. Any context — a job, school, family. Two paragraphs is plenty. No cover letter format, no buzzwords.

Pay: From $16\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

In 2023, Home Chef introduced a new brand, Tempo! Tempo features a rotating selection of ready\-to\-heat meals delivered directly to your door. These meals are better\-for\-you versions of familiar favorites, designed to save you time and reduce stress while maintaining a healthy lifestyle. Our Tempo menu includes options that are protein\-packed, fiber\-rich, calorie and carb conscious, keto\-friendly, and dietitian\-approved.



Similar to our recipes, we recognize that variety is the spice of life, and therefore, our employees also bring their uniqueness and color to our fantastic team. We're eager to work with humble team players and pragmatic next\-level thinkers to innovate on Home Chef's offerings.

  



The Customer Experience Associate Position operates **Monday \- Friday from 10:00am \- 6:30pm CST**.



Please note: the training for this role begins on **Monday 10/26 and runs for 3 weeks**, **Monday \- Friday 9:00am to 5:30p CST**. It is a requirement that all new hires are available to attend for the entirety of the training.



Our Customer Experience Associate serves as the front line of communication between the company and our customers. Representatives will respond to customer issues, complaints and inquiries via phone, email and chat.



The Customer Experience Associate is primarily responsible for handling fundamental customer issues such as making account updates, assisting with the use of the platform, and documenting incidents via live support channels. You will train and learn the platform's basics and use in\-house resources, problem\-solving, and people skills to support customers. We aim to live our values in every interaction and are looking for Customer Support Associates who care deeply about making everyday lives easier.



As a Customer Support Associate, you will spend your productive time working directly with customers via chat, phone, or email.


**Detailed Responsibilities**  

Our shift schedules remain static (the days you work) but your activities per shift will remain fluid and may change depending on business needs. Flexibility and adaptability are required when approaching daily ticket handling responsibilities.  

  

***Participate in Ticket Handling***


* Participate in Ticket Handling on Voice Channel:
* + Assist customers via incoming phone calls.
	+ Spend up to 24 hours per week on the phone channel.
	+ Shows up to each shift, spending the proper scheduled amount of time online.
	+ Does not miss or decline phone calls unless communicated to team lead.
	+ Averages around 10 calls per hour.
* Participate in Ticket Handling on Email Channel:
* + Assist customers via inbound email and web form tickets.
	+ Spend up to 10 hours per week on the email channel
	+ Shows up to each shift, replying to roughly 12 email tickets per hour.
	+ Cleans out personal 'inbox' daily, responding to all replies within 24 hours.
* Participate in Ticket Handling on Chat Channel:
* + Assist customers via inbound AI chat (helpshift).
	+ Spends up to 12 hours per week on the chat channel.
	+ Responds to each chat within a defined SLA period.

***Research and Understand Current Trends and Issues from Customers***


* + Participate in daily/weekly team meetings and stand\-ups.
	+ Actively looks for trends in our customer inquiries.
	+ Researches and resolves complicated issues.
	+ Contributes to root\-cause analysis of new bugs, operational misses, and service disruptions.

**Qualifications**  

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, ability and/or other characteristics needed for this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities.


* Prior experience in Customer Support or related positions (restaurants, retail, etc.)
* General high school degree, or equivalent
* Positive attitude in regards to customer communication, as well as team collaboration.
* Solid communication skills – both verbal and written
* Fledgling analysis skills \- understands how to spot trends and research common themes
* Can type a minimum 50 wpm

**We take ownership.**

new_jobs.title: Digital Ad Operations Specialist, Level 2
new_jobs.description:
**Digital Ad Operations Specialist, Level 2**  


The **Digital Ad Operations Specialist, Level 2**, joins a team responsible for Farm Journal digital campaigns from conception to completion. This role manages both programmatic and paid social campaigns, with an intermediate understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem and Farm Journal’s portfolio of brands. The Level 2 specialist executes campaigns involving 5 or more ad groups across multiple platforms with limited mistakes, and proactively communicates campaign insights and performance recommendations without waiting to be prompted by leadership.  


The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and growing in their ability to troubleshoot underperforming campaigns, apply audience strategy, and support team leads on escalated matters. At this level, team members are expected to accurately launch 75\-100 new campaigns per month while continuing to manage previously live campaigns, including medium\-complexity campaigns defined by multiple flights, audience intersections, creative breakouts, or pixel\-focused setups.  


**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
*These duties include, but are not limited to, the following. Other duties may be assigned.*  


* Work collaboratively in a matrixed structure to execute and deliver on all digital campaigns across programmatic and paid social channels.
* Execute and manage paid social campaigns across multiple platforms, including but not limited to Facebook (Meta), LinkedIn, Snapchat, YouTube, and TikTok.
* Build and launch programmatic campaigns across relevant DSPs and ad\-serving platforms, adhering to best practices for all tactics (display, audio, native, video).
* Execute campaign setups with 5\+ ad groups across several platforms with a high degree of accuracy and within established SLAs.
* Troubleshoot basic to intermediate campaign issues—including delivery, pacing, creative, and audience—with limited supervision.
* Optimize programmatic and social campaigns with an intermediate understanding of performance levers, working toward best ROI for clients.
* Apply advanced audience knowledge including lookback audiences, lookalike audiences, audience intersections, contextual targeting, and affinity segments.
* Review campaign orders and determine appropriate campaign structure (number of ad groups vs. multiple campaigns, best serving platform, and reporting approach).
* Proactively communicate campaign insights, performance updates, and basic optimization recommendations to team leads and Client Success Managers (CSMs) without being prompted.
* Support team leads on all escalated matters within assigned account lists.
* Maintain advanced working knowledge of general team processes including audience takedown, Naviga functionality, and reporting workflows.
* Develop and maintain a foundational understanding of pixel and tag types, including placement and verification.
* Contribute to cross\-functional team relationships and execute within processes that connect with other internal teams.
* Grow industry knowledge across all Farm Journal brands, target audiences, and company initiatives.

  


**Skills/Professional Experience**
*These qualifications include, but are not limited to, the following:*  


**Core Competencies**  


* Analytical thinking and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Technical expertise across programmatic and paid social platforms.
* Initiative and proactive communication.
* High integrity and accountability.
* Attention to detail and organizational discipline.

  


**Required**  


* BS/BA degree in a related area (marketing, data analytics, business administration) or equivalent work experience.
* 2–4 years of direct experience in digital ad operations, programmatic campaign management, or paid social campaign management (or approximately 4–8 months of progression within a structured ad ops team).
* Proven aptitude for growth and demonstrated capacity to learn new platforms quickly.
* High level of attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Working knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, including programmatic and paid social channels.
* In\-platform experience across at least one major DSP or social advertising platform.
* Ability to manage a sizable volume of campaigns simultaneously with speed and accuracy.
* Problem solver—brings solutions, not just alerts.
* Highly self\-motivated with the ability to execute with limited supervision.

  


**Desired**  


* Prior experience with programmatic platforms (Google Ads \& TradeDesk) and/or paid social platforms (Facebook/Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager).
* Familiarity with audience\-building strategies including lookalike, lookback, and contextual targeting.
* Experience with pixel implementation, tag management, and campaign measurement (impressions, reach, CTR, viewability).
* Microsoft Excel proficiency: pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and related functions.
* Basic understanding of reporting tools and data visualization.
* Growing awareness of Farm Journal brands and agricultural media audiences.
* Experience with endemic media channels, including email blast execution and ad serving within Google Ad Manager (GAM); familiarity with HubSpot or similar email/CRM platforms is a plus

  


**Work Authorization Requirements**
Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.  


**EEO statement**
Farm Journal is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.  


**Other Duties**
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the team member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
